Optical signals and UHF signals were measured synchronously when the partial discharge occurred. The results demonstrate that optical signals matched well with UHF signals and had a good linear relationship. Besides, both amplitudes of optical signals and UHF signals increased with the rise of the applied voltage. The surface discharge had a larger discharge amplitude but a lower repetition rate than the corona discharge under the same applied voltage. The results show that both the multi-band helical antenna and SiPM can be used to detect partial discharge.

articleTitle: The impact of overhead line length on ferroresonance in low-loss distribution transformers
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Ferroresonance is a non-linear and complex electrical phenomenon that is due to the interaction between the capacitance of a cable, or overhead line, connected to the transformer and the saturable magnetising inductance of a transformer. Ferroresonance has been related to the failure of electrical equipment because of dangerous overvoltages produced in power transmission and distribution networks. The incidence of ferroresonance is strongly linked to the no-load core loss of a transformer. Therefore, the use of a reduced core loss transformer becomes a potentially serious problem for the safety of the power system, because of its effect on ferroresonance. This paper discusses the investigation into the effects of ferroresonance on the lengths of overhead transmission lines connected to low-loss distribution transformers. A 22 kV distribution network system was simulated, consisting of an overhead line energising/de-energising a 3-phase (3ϕ) low loss distribution transformer under no-load conditions. The simulation was conducted by utilising the ATP (Alternative Transients Program) and the switching procedures with opened single phase, two phase, and three phase that were given as a transient that introduced ferroresonance. Also, the critical lengths of overhead lines, which establish sufficient capacitive reactance for the occurrence of the phenomenon of ferroresonance, were determined.

articleTitle: The formation mechanism of white powder in cable water blocking tape and its influence on volume resistivity and thermal conductivity
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In recent years, buffer layer failures of high-voltage cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cables have occurred frequently. After dissecting the faulty cable, there are white powders on the surface of water blocking tape. Thus, it is of great significance to study the formation of the powder and its role in the failures. In this paper, the authors conduct several tests to study the contribution of pressure, moisture and current in the generation of powder, as well as the contribution of the aluminium sheath.In addition, the influence of the degree of moisture and white powder content of the water blocking tape on the volume resistivity and thermal conductivity was studied. The research shows that moisture and aluminium sheath are determining factors to form the white powder, while pressure and current play the role of acceleration. At powder area of the tape, volume resistivity rises with increasing powder, from 5.3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> Ω·cm to 4.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> Ω·cm, and thermal conductivity decreases from 8.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> W/(m·K) to 1.9×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> W/(m·K). The research results of this paper can provide reference for the analysis of the ablation failure of the buffer layer of the high-voltage cable.

articleTitle: Defects location of multi-impedance mismatched of power cables based on FDR method with dolph-chebyshev window
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Cross linked polyethylene (XLPE) cable has been widely used in urban power transmission and distribution system. The accurate location of cable partial defect is of great significance to maintain the safe operation of the cable. In this research, a method of cable partial defect diagnosis based on frequency domain reflectometry (FDR) is proposed. Firstly, the mathematical model of cable transmission line is established, and the basic principle of this method is described. Then, the Dolph-Chebyshev window function is selected to eliminate the inaccuracy of positioning results caused by signal spectrum leakage. And through the feasibility of this method is explored by establishing a simulation model. Finally, several experiments were carried out on 10kV XLPE cables in Chengdu. The results show that the diagnosis conclusions of cable intermediate joints and local defects location are basically consistent with the cable account information and the actual situation. Which indicate that the method is feasible for locating and diagnosing local defects and intermediate joints.

articleTitle: Influence of zinc oxide nanoparticles on dielectric performance of natural ester oil
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In this study, the effect of semi-conductive zinc oxide nanoparticles on the dielectric performance of natural ester oil FR3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TM</sup> is addressed. The nanoparticles are integrated in the oil volume in weight percentages of 0.004% (zNF1) and 0.008% w/w (zNF2). AC Breakdown Voltage of the nanofluid samples is measured and compared to the respective properties of both the base oil and the nanofluids-containing SiC nanoparticles. Furthermore, the Partial Discharge Inception Voltage of Nomex<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> Dupont<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TM</sup> paper impregnated in NF samples is determined and explained. The processing of the results shows that zinc oxide nanoparticles can increase the dielectric strength of the transformer oil only in the lower concentration (zNF1) by 7%, while zNF2 has a reduced AC breakdown voltage by 17.1%. In terms of Partial discharge ignition voltage, it is found that the paper impregnated to zNF1 shows increased partial discharge ignition voltage with respect to paper impregnated to zNF2 by 25%.

articleTitle: Identification method of turn-to-turn short circuit fault in low voltage winding of 220KV transformer
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Multi frequency coupling factors exist in the inter turn short circuit fault of transformer low-voltage winding, which affects the fault identification degree. A fault identification method for interturn short circuit of 220 kV transformer low-voltage winding is proposed. The equivalent circuit topology model is established by inputting control parameters, and the voltage gain is obtained to obtain the dynamic characteristic detection model of short circuit fault. Under the load balancing scheduling, the multi frequency coupling parameters of inter turn short circuit fault are extracted according to the frequency oscillation caused by the inter turn phase locked loop. The stability criterion and harmonic resonance detection are used to fuse the information of inter turn short circuit fault, and the parameters are optimized and identified, The fuzzy state analytical model of fault parameters is obtained, and then the short circuit fault detection and diagnosis output are completed according to the feature clustering results, and the short circuit fault optimal identification is realized according to the results of feature clustering and diagnosis detection. The simulation results show that the accuracy of turn to turn short circuit fault detection of 220 kV transformer low-voltage winding is high and the fault identification is good.

articleTitle: Long term dga trend evaluation of transmission power transformers
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The deterioration of transformer insulation materials results in the formation of gases and oxidation products. The main gases are hydrogen, hydrocarbons and carbon oxides. The gases are dissolved in the transformer oil and they are periodically measured for transformer health assessment, which is known as Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA). In this paper, a study was performed to determine the influence of the transformer service age on the DGA trends. Around 40,000 DGA data samples from 672 in-service transmission power transformers, from new transformers up to 63 years in service in the UK, were used in this study. The 50<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>, 75<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> and 90<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> percentile values of gas level were computed for each gas in ppm at every service age in years to understand the central tendency of gassing trends along with the service age. In this analysis, three trend patterns were observed. Firstly, hydrogen values are independent of the service age. Secondly, methane, ethane and ethylene tend to stay constant up to around 50 years, before increasing noticeably. Finally, carbon oxides increase gradually with a decremental rate. These observations provide insights into incorporating transformer age in substantiating DGA based condition assessment.

articleTitle: Qualification of MVAC XLPE cables for DC operation
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: As a consequence of the energy transition, DC transmission in the medium voltage level is becoming ever more important. Decentralized energy production and rising energy consumption are the main reasons for the increasing interest. One approach is the conversion of MVAC cable systems to MVDC cable systems or to use new MVAC cable equipment in MVDC cable systems. It is first necessary to establish a qualification procedure for MVAC cable systems under DC stress, however, as there is none available at present. The MVAC cables and accessories are thus investigated with multiphysical FEM simulations. The FEM simulations include measured temperature profiles from the accessories to receive a realistic temperature behaviour in the thermal-electric simulations. The conductivity of the cable insulation (XLPE) is taken from leakage current measurements. The simulations show time constants for the field transition in the cable in the range of minutes and electric fields in the cable system under 13 kV/mm for VDC = ±55 kV. Furthermore, this contribution provides a proposal for a qualification procedure for MVAC cable systems used as MVDC cable systems, which includes FEM simulations, partial discharge, leakage current, space charge measurements and breakdown tests.

articleTitle: Research on the power frequency breakdown characteristics of a new eco-friendly gas insulating medium HFO-1336mzz(E)
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Recently, a new eco-friendly gas insulating medium HFO-1336mzz(E) (trans-1,1,1,4,4,4-hexafluoro-2-butene, chemical formula: C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>) has entered the field of vision of researchers. HFO-1336mzz(E) has good environmental protection characteristics, high insulation strength, and is considered to be one of the powerful potential gases to replace SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> in medium and low voltage equipment. This paper compares the insulation performance of HFO-1336mzz(E) gas mixture with CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> as buffer gas, and finds that the effect of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is better. Secondly, the quasi-uniform electric field was simulated by spherical electrode, and the breakdown voltage of HFO-1336mzz(E)/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixture under different gas pressure and mixing ratio was investigated. The results show that the breakdown voltage of the gas mixture with volume fraction 10%∼30% HFO-1336mzz(E)/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> increases linearly with the increase of gas pressure and mixing ratio. The breakdown voltages of 20%HFO-1336mzz(E) /CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixture at 0.25MPa and 0.3MPa can reach 80% and 95.2% of that of pure SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> at 0.1MPa respectively. Relevant research results show that HFO-1336mzz(E)/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixture has good insulation performance, which provides a reference for its engineering application.

articleTitle: Analysis of moisture diffusion of oil-impregnated bushing under axial non-uniform distribution based on FEM and Fick's second Law
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The moisture inside the oil-impregnated (OIP) bushing will accumulate in the tail area of the capacitor core, which results in an obvious axial moisture gradient. However, there lacks an effective tool to analyze the reason caused this phenomenon. Given this issue, this work simulates the moisture diffusion process of OIP bushing under the non-uniform distribution of moisture based on the finite element method (FEM) and Fick's second law. The simulation results can accord with the law of moisture diffusion at the end of the actual bushing, and the accuracy of the moisture diffusion model is thus verified. The obtained findings reveal that the proposed model can well describe the non-uniform distribution of moisture inside the OIP bushing capacitor core.

articleTitle: Experimental study on temperature rise of 40.5 kV switchgear with heater installed
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of condensation in 40.5 kV high-voltage switchgear under low temperature and high humidity conditions, this paper adopts the reasonable layout strategy of heaters to reduce the relative humidity in the cabinet. Firstly, the effective heating space test of single heater with different types, power and installation modes is carried out. Then, combined with the heating characteristics of different single heaters and the actual structure distribution of 40.5 kV switchgear cable room, several different types of heater combinations are determined. Finally, the effective temperature rise test of different types of heater combinations is carried out in 40.5 kV switchgear, based on the uniformity of experimental data, the heater combination scheme corresponding to the target temperature rise is determined. The results show that the heater layout scheme determined by this method is more purposeful than blind heater installation, and the target temperature rise is more uniform. The research results provide experimental support and necessary theoretical basis for the heater layout of 40.5 kV high-voltage switchgear, which has practical application value.

articleTitle: Research on the propagation characteristics of ultrasonic signals generated by partial discharge in GIS under different structures
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Partial discharge is an important factor leading to cracking of the internal insulation of GIS. In GIS partial discharge detection, the ultrasonic method has been widely used because of its high sensitivity and strong anti-interference ability. However, for different GIS structures, the acoustic field distribution characteristics of the ultrasonic signal generated by partial discharge in the GIS and on the surface of the cavity are different, which have an important impact on the sensitivity and accuracy of the ultrasonic detection results. Therefore, it is necessary to study the propagation characteristics of ultrasonic signals generated by partial discharge in GIS. This article buildt the T-type and L-type three-phase sub-box GIS simulation models in the comsol simulation software. With SF6 gas at 4.4 atmospheres, the propagation characteristics of ultrasonic signals inside GIS equipment with different structures were simulated respectively.The simulation results have shown that the ultrasonic signal amplitude was basically inversely proportional to the propagation distance. The metal guide rod had a serious hindrance to the ultrasonic signal propagation. The bottom of the GIS was an important sensor installation position.The research results have great application value for improving the sensitivity and anti-interference ability of ultrasonic method in the field of GIS partial discharge insulation defect diagnosis.

articleTitle: Comparative study on the performance of Itaconic Acid based epoxy resin and bisphenol a epoxy resin
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In this paper, in order to explore the application prospects of environmental-friendly bio-based epoxy resins in the electrical field, the advantages and disadvantages of itaconic acid-based epoxy resin (EIA), a bio-based resin, were compared with bisphenol A epoxy resin (DGEBA) in terms of physical and chemical parameters and electrical insulation properties. The results show that the epoxy equivalent of EIA is close to that of DGEBA, and both resins have typical viscosity-temperature characteristics, and the rheological properties of EIA are slightly better than that of DGEBA, ensuring its processability; The water absorption and high-temperature hydrolysis capacity of EIA are slightly higher than DGEBA, which limits its outdoor application prospects; The breakdown voltage of the EIA curing system (32.1kV/mm) is slightly lower than that of the DGEBA system (36.7kV/mm), while the leakage current of the EIA curing system is about 13.1% higher than that of DGEBA, indicating that the electrical insulation performance of EIA is slightly weaker than that of DGEBA. In summary, as a matrix resin, EIA is inferior to DGEBA in terms of electrical strength due to the influence of crosslink density and intramolecular ester bonds. However, the viscosity properties are similar, and EIA is more excellent in terms of degradability and environmental protection, etc. In the later stage, EIA can be modified to increase the degree of crosslinking and blended with other types of epoxy resins such as bisphenol A to improve its application prospects.

articleTitle: Adsorption characteristics of moisture in insulating paper and its influence on charge transport
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Moisture is one of the most important factors contributing to the deterioration of insulating paper. Increased moisture promotes the transport of space charge in oil-paper insulation, distorting the electric field and accelerating the aging progress of cellulose insulation. This paper focuses on the microscopic mechanism of moisture changing the characteristics of charge transport in insulating paper. Firstly, cellulose models with different moisture contents are established by using molecular dynamics simulation methods, and the adsorption characteristics of moisture in cellulose are analysed. Then the detailed influences of moisture on the electrostatic potential (ESP) and the density of states (DOS) of cellulose are analysed by quantum chemical calculations. The results show that most of the water molecules in the insulating are bonded to the hydroxyl groups on the cellulose chain by hydrogen bonds, while there are almost no hydrogen bonds between water molecules. After attracting water molecules, the electrostatic potential near the hydroxyl group decreases and the ability of the hydroxyl group to attract other particles is weakened. Thus the charges in cellulose insulation are more easily transported rather than trapped, which may be responsible for the influence of moisture on the charge transport in oil-paper insulation.

articleTitle: Determination of gas solubility coefficients for DGA analysis
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Condition assessment of transformers in service is widely based on fault gas analysis of the insulation liquid, namely dissolved gas analysis (DGA). The seven key fault gases commonly used in transformer diagnostics are hydrogen, methane, ethane, ethylene, acetylene, carbon monoxide, and carbon dioxide. The amount of gases is predominantly measured in gas phase, but results reported in oil phase i.e. μ-litre of gas in litre of oil or ppm. Thus, to get gas concentrations in oil, the gas phase concentrations need to be converted by using so called partition coefficients that define how much gases can dissolve in oil. Solubility of gases is affected by oil temperature and chemical composition of oil, for example. Authors evaluated the effect of variation in published coefficients as well as gas extraction methods to the actual fault diagnostics. In this study, the coefficients were determined for several oil samples, used and new mineral oils with two methods, phase ratio variation and headspace vapor phase calibration. The results were reported in relation to widely used gas in oil standard. It was also studied if gas concentration affects the partition coefficient.

articleTitle: Simulation study on steady-state ampacity of ± 400 kV DC submarine cable under different laying environments
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In recent years, with the change of energy use and the development of the power grid, high-voltage direct current (HVDC) submarine cable has been becoming an indispensable part for the interconnection of clean energy bases and load power system centers across the sea. A steady-state ampacity determined by the thermal characteristics of the cable components and surrounding medium is of great significance to the safe operation of submarine cable. In this work, the steady-state ampacity of ±400 kV DC submarine cable is calculated based on the COMSOL Multiphysics software. An electro-thermal-fluid coupling model of the submarine cable is built, and various laying conditions such as J-tube and cable trench are considered for the calculation. The electric field distribution and steady-state ampacity of the cable laying in J-tube and mudflat parts are simulated separately with the maximum long-term working temperature as the constraint. The results show that the steady-state ampacity of cables running in J-tube filled with seawater is about 1500A higher than that with air. The temperature difference of the insulation layer determines the electric field distribution, and the maximum field intensity may occur on the outer or inner surface of the insulation layer. The buried depth and size of cable trench are crucial to affect the steady-state ampacity of cables.

articleTitle: Perspectives of temperature assessment based on wave propagation for dynamic rating of medium-voltage power cables
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: This paper explores the feasibility of wave propagation characteristics as means of probing the temperature of an underground power cable. It utilises the relation between wave velocity and relative permittivity. The permittivity and its temperature dependency are specific for the applied insulation materials. The investigated cable is a three-phase XLPE-insulated mediumvoltage cable with a common earth screen. Combined thermal and electromagnetic analysis is applied to account for the temperature distribution over the cable cross section. The corresponding permittivity distribution is based on the temperature dependency measured for an XLPE sample. Temperature monitoring is achieved by observing the signal transit time along the power cable. The measured variation in signal propagation velocity and attenuation, compared to model predictions, provides an estimate of the cable temperature. It is shown that a sensitivity within 2°C can be achieved for a temperature near the maximum operating value for XLPE insulation.

articleTitle: Detection scheme of commutation failure based on temporal features of thyristor valve in the on-state and off-state
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Commutation failure, which frequently occurs in HVDC systems, results in the current flowing through each thyristor valve is unbalanced. Suppose some valves of the converter are in an over-current or over-heated state for a long time. In that case, it will seriously affect normal operation of the converter and threatens the stable operation of the power grid. Converter protection criterion is mainly constructed by the balance principle of the current. The study found that differential current represents the converter bypass state, which cannot accurately reflect the state of commutation failure. This paper starts with detecting the width of the valve in the on-state and off-state. Proposes a detection scheme for commutation failure based on the temporal features of AC current on the valve-side. This detection scheme can locate valves that have commutation failure for the first time. During normal operation, conduction width and shut-off width of the valve are constant; the widths will change when commutation failure occurs; which can judge abnormal valve. With the relationship between abnormal valve states can judge commutation failure. Finally, simulation results verify the validity. It can quickly and sensitively detect commutation failure and is less affecting by fault factors.

articleTitle: Effect of material choice on the operation of a wind turbine lightning protection system
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to simulate various cases of lightning strikes at a wind turbine blade and evaluate both the effectiveness of the Lightning Protection System (LPS) and the behavior of the blade composite materials. The simulation is performed in the COMSOL Multiphysics software. In order to draw conclusions about the effects of lightning strike on the materials, the temperature developed is evaluated. The first conclusion of the study is that Carbon Fiber Reinforced Plastic (CFRP) develops significantly higher temperatures than Glass Reinforced Plastic (GRP). Regarding the cross-section of down conductor, the study showed that in the rare case of a 200 kA lightning strike, the use of steel down conductor with the minimum appropriate cross-section is not sufficient to protect the blade. For the case of multiple strikes, it appeared that the thermal energy does not manage to be released and therefore each sequential strike has an additive effect on the rise of temperature.

articleTitle: Development of standard wave source for impulse current traceability
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The accuracy of impulse current measurement directly affects the performance evaluation of lightning protection equipment, and is related to the safety and economy of power equipment operation. The premise of establishing the standard measurement system of impulse current to realize the traceability of the measurement value is to develop the standard measuring device of impulse current and the standard equipment for the traceability of the measurement value. The standard wave source and the impulse current source are used to calibrate the parameters of the impulse current scale for the digital recorder and the whole set of measuring devices. The 800V impulse voltage standard wave source is developed. The uncertainty of peak value measurement is 0.1% (k=2) and the uncertainty of time parameter measurement is 1.2% (k=2). It can be used for calibration of scale factor and time parameter of digital recorder.

articleTitle: Application research of ultraviolet imaging, leakage current and acoustic emission signal in composite insulator defect detection
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Transmission line insulators are affected by electricity and thermal stress for a long time, which will cause damage and defects to reduce their insulation performance and cause discharge. This will threaten the normal operation of the power system. Traditional manual line inspection methods for detecting damaged defects are greatly affected by manual experience and easy to cause missed detection. Ultraviolet imaging method has high sensitivity to insulator discharge. This paper proposes and builds a detection method and test platform based on the combination of discharge acoustic emission, leakage current and ultraviolet image. In the laboratory, the acoustic, leakage current and ultraviolet discharge image characteristics of 35kV suspended composite insulator are studied when the umbrella skirts are defected. The results show that the joint detection method can effectively detect the damaged defects of the insulators and reflect the severity of the discharge, so as to effectively diagnose and prevent the defects of the transmission line insulators.

articleTitle: Effect of water content on DC conduction and space charge characteristics of the nanocomposites of crosslinked polyethylene
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: It is proved that adding nano materials into crosslinked polyethylene can restrain the accumulation of space charge. However, as the nano particles are easy to absorb moisture, this may lead to the change of DC conduction and space charge characteristics of the nanocomposites. In this paper, low density polyethylene (LDPE), cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE), aluminium oxide/cross-linked polyethylene (Al2O3/XLPE) and silicon dioxide/cross-linked polyethylene (SiO2/XLPE) were selected and stored at 97% relative humidity (RH) for 80 days to absorb water. The water absorption of the samples was recorded. In addition, the conductivity and the space charge characteristics of the four samples under a series of water content were measured and analysed in detail. The conductivities of LDPE and pure XLPE increased significantly after water absorption, and hetero-charges were mainly accumulated in the samples; while the conductivities of Al2O3/XLPE and SiO2/XLPE decreased after water absorption, and homo-charges were mainly accumulated in the samples. The mechanism behind the changes of the four materials after water absorption was explained. This study provided an important experimental basis for understanding the effect of water content on the conductivity and space charge characteristics of the four polyethylene materials.

articleTitle: Accurately measuring the structure parameters of insulators in real time by using structured light illumination
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Insulators are important electrical devices in electrical power systems, and their quality is directly related to the safety of transmission lines. Randomly inspected the length, height, and especially creepage distance of insulators can be treated as the key parameters determining the quality of the insulators, while traditional manually inspecting those parameters is of huge workload and low efficiency. In order to overcome the shortcomings of the traditional methods, in this paper, we propose to accurately detect the key size parameters of insulators in real time via structured light illumination. For scanned 3D point clouds of insulators, we also develop advanced software to automatically computer various size parameters including creepage distance. Experimental results show that compared the traditional method, the proposed method can improve inspection speed by a factor of 20x and control the relative error of measured size within 2%.

articleTitle: Simulation of space charge characteristics of epoxy resin under pulse voltage
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Epoxy resin is widely used in GIS/GIL, power electronic equipment and other electrical equipment as insulation material. In the process of application, epoxy resin may face space charge accumulation caused by various pulse overvoltage, resulting in insulation degradation. In this paper, bipolar carrier transport model is established and the space charge accumulation characteristics of epoxy resin under pulse voltage are studied by simulation, and the effects of pulse frequency and pulse width on the space charge characteristics are analysed. The results show that a small amount of space charge is injected into the epoxy resin material under pulse voltage and rapidly tends to saturation, while there is a dynamic reciprocal process of carrier injection and extraction, which may cause degradation of the insulation material. The increase of both pulse frequency and pulse width leads to an increase in the saturation value of space charge accumulation. When pulse width increases, the number of pulses needed for space charge to accumulate to saturation value is reduced.

articleTitle: AIMD calculation on electron ionization induced fragmentations of C5F10O and its discharge decomposition products
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Recently, perfluoroketone C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>O has been regarded as a promising alternative gas for SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>, of which the global warming potential (GWP) is extremely high. C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>O has a good insulation property and the GWP value is only 1, thus can be used as insulation medium in gas-insulated switchgears. In this study, the decomposition products of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>O under partial discharges are detected and qualitatively analysed by gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS). The stable products like C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>, C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>, C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sub>, C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> and CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O are formed. Meanwhile, to theoretically obtain the gas phase fragmentation pathways of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>O and its decomposition products upon 70eV electron ionization, a method of combined stochastic and ab initio molecular dynamics simulations are carried out. The calculation could be performed without preconceived fragmentation channels, which simulate standard electron ionization mass spectrometry (EI-MS) conditions. The significant peaks in the experimental mass spectrum of the molecules could be reproduced well, indicating that the simulation accurately predicts the decomposition channel after electron-impact ionization. Moreover, the fragmentation channels for C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>O by 20 eV electron ionization, which is not standard in EI-MS but near the ionization threshold, are also calculated. We suggest that the quantum chemistry calculation method could provide an insight into fragmentation processes for different gases during discharges, which is still quite unclear for the novel SF6-alternative gases.

articleTitle: Moisture dependent surface charge behavior of fluorinated oil-impregnated paper under the harmonic superimposed DC voltages
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Due to the power electronics and non-linear equipment, the oil-impregnated paper of valve side bushing is suffered by the harmonic voltage. Besides, moisture has a detrimental effect on oil-impregnated paper lifespan by lowering electrical breakdown strength and thermal endurance. Hence, the charges are capable to accumulate on the surface of oil-impregnated paper, which will lead to the distorting the electric field and accelerating the insulating degradation. Consequently, the performance deterioration of oil-impregnated paper is inevitable. This paper is dedicated to research the surface charge behavior of fluorinated oil-impregnated paper with different moisture under the harmonic superimposed DC voltage. The insulating paper were put in the constant temperature and humidity chamber to moisture absorption for 15, 30 and 45 min respectively, of which the relative humidity was set to 40% and the temperature was set to 40 °C. Some conclusions can be drawn that the moisture induces the shallow trap. The comprehensive effect of harmonic voltage and moisture can significantly enhance the discrepancy appeared in the decay rate. Furthermore, the energy level of the traps on the specimen surface increases and is influenced by the different electric field.

articleTitle: Study of controlled switching with preinsertion resistor during energization of AC filters
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: AC filters plays an important role in DC transmission system, as they can compensate reactive power consumed by the converter station and filter out the harmonic components. To suppress the switching transients during energization of AC filters, controlled switching device and circuit breakers with pre-insertion resistor are adopted commonly. This paper studied the relationship between the switching transients and switching angle and resistor insertion time which affect the closing inrush current directly by theoretical analysis and simulation calculation. Then the optimal controlled switching strategy to minimize the switching transients during energization of different AC filters using controlled switching device with circuit breakers with pre-insertion resistor is presents.

articleTitle: Research on the relevance of flow electrification characteristics under AC and DC voltages
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: As flow electrification phenomenon may cause hazards to converter transformer, the mechanisms underlying the formation of streaming current should be studied. According to our former works, the effects of space charge on oil flow electrification characteristics under DC voltage is analyzed. But the relevance of flow electrification characteristics under AC and DC voltage is still unknown. In this paper, an oil circulating system with plane electrode is built to study the flow electrification characteristic. Then the effect of voltage type and frequence on oil flow electrification characteristics is studied. Compared to our former experimental results, the correlationship of formation mechanism of flow electrification under DC and AC voltage is analyzed. Ultimately, it provides theoretical and technical support for the design, manufacture and safe operation of converter transformers

articleTitle: Differential lightning protection assessment of transmission lines
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The topography of Xinjiang is diverse, and lightning activities are frequent in some areas of the region in summer. With the development of Xinjiang UHV construction project, the requirements of lightning monitoring and protection of power grid are also increasing. The differentiated lightning protection of transmission lines will scientifically integrate the lightning information, landform parameters and basic information of transmission lines, which will affect the lightning withstand level of transmission lines, and form a line lightning protection technology that can accurately screen potential high-risk towers and formulate high economic transformation scheme. Based on the statistics of lightning parameters, the tripping rate model of lightning tower is established, and the lightning protection performance of tower is judged by the indexes. The reliability of transmission line is evaluated by means of first evaluation, then treatment and then summary.

articleTitle: Improvement on dynamic drop test for dynamic hydrophobicity measurement
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Insulators for high voltage transmission lines are of extreme significance nowadays as the voltage gets higher and the capacity gets larger. Among them, silicone rubber (SR) composite insulators are getting more and more popular due to their hydrophobicity, convenience for maintenance and light weight. What highlight them most is the excellent hydrophobicity, especially the ability of hydrophobic transfer, making them also more widely used in substation insulators and bushings. There are several kinds of methods for evaluating hydrophobicity of solid insulating materials and dynamic drop test (DDT) is recognized by CIGRE. In this paper, the degradation process of hydrophobicity during the DDT was revealed. Three main phases were identified. Also, the influence of several main test parameters of DDT on failure time was investigated. Recommendations about solvent concentration, structure of electrodes, and amplitude of voltage were given accordingly. Based on the results, improvement of test setup was proposed and verified by simulation as well as experiment.

articleTitle: Distortion and reduction method of 3-D total electric field on buildings near ±800kV transmission lines
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The limited transmission corridors and large-scale construction of ultra high voltage direct current (UHVDC) projects make buildings inevitably close to high voltage direct current (HVDC) lines. Due to the lack of relevant standards, it is urgent to study the total electric field distribution and reduction methods near buildings. In order to solve the problem, a time domain calculation method based on the convection diffusion equation was used. The finite element analysis software Comsol Multiphysics and Matlab were used for joint simulation to complete the implementation of the algorithm. Due to its advantages in model building and finite element solving, the visualization software Comsol Multiphysics could reduce programming difficulty and improve efficiency. Based on the method, the calculation result of unipolar line was in good agreement with measurement in the laboratory, which verified the reliability of the calculation method. The distribution characteristics of 3-D total electrical fields on building near a ±800kV transmission line were calculated and analysed. To reduce the distortion, methods of applying shielding and changing the position of buildings were studied and discussed. The research results could provide support for the design and reduction method of the complex total electric field on buildings near HVDC transmission lines.

articleTitle: Study on space charge characteristics in XLPE/EPDM composite under DC superimposed impulse voltage
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In DC transmission line, the cable line suffers the interference of operating overvoltage which causes operating DC voltage superimposed on the impulse voltage. Space charge is an important factor of insulation damage under high electric stress, so in this paper, the space charge characteristics in XLPE/EPDM composite were measured under DC superimposed impulse voltage. The results show that impulse voltage alone can cause the accumulation of space charges with different polarities at the XLPE/EPDM composite interface. When DC electric stress is applied on alone, the accumulated charges at the interface decrease with the increasing DC electric stress, and the negative DC electric stress has a greater influence on the space charge accumulation than positive DC electric stress. When DC stress is superimposed on impulse stresses together, if DC voltage superimposes impulse voltage with same polarity, the equivalent DC electric field is multiplied and results in the reversal of space charge accumulation at the XLPE/EPDM interface. When DC voltage superimposes impulse voltage with opposite polarity, interface charge decreases due to obey the dielectric constant distribution under AC electric stress.

articleTitle: Detection of SF6 decomposition components SO2F2 and SOF2 based on mid-infrared laser photoacoustic spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The partial discharge caused by the defects of GIS can decompose SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas. The insulation condition of GIS can be effectively diagnosed and evaluated by detecting the content of decomposition components. The detection of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> decomposition components SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is particularly important. Photoacoustic spectroscopy has good stability and high sensitivity. Through the analysis of infrared absorption spectra of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas, it is found that SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas has the strongest absorption peak in 1504cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> band and SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas has the strongest absorption peak in 1340cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> band. The mid infrared quantum cascade laser and high sensitivity microphone are used to build the photoacoustic spectrum detection platform of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The drive current and temperature of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> lasers are calibrated, and the detailed parameters of the laser are determined. The high level 8V and 3.5V of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> lasers are set. The SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> lasers were set at 19.7 °C and 18.1 °C. Through the research on the signal-to-noise ratio of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in different frequencies under the background of nitrogen, it is concluded that the best signal-to-noise ratio of the two gases is 10Hz and 15Hz.

articleTitle: Study on the acute inhalation toxicity of eco-friendly gas insulating medium C5-PFK
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The eco-friendly insulating gas C5-PFK is considered promising to replace SF6 as an insulating medium in gas-insulated equipment. At present, there are few reports on the acute inhalation toxicity of C5-PFK gas, leaving hidden dangers for related scientific research and engineering applications. In this paper, by setting up an eco-friendly gas insulating medium acute inhalation test platform, with experimental mice as the research object, a 4h acute inhalation toxicity test study of C5-PFK gas was carried out according to the OECD403 test guide. The study found that after acute inhalation of low-concentration C5-PFK gas, mice will experience symptoms such as excitement, heartbeat and shortness of breath, but will return to normal after a few hours. There will be no abnormalities during the 14-day observation period and their physical condition is good. After acute inhalation of high-concentration C5-PFK gas, mice will become paralyzed and lose their ability to move independently, leading to death. The LC50 of 4h acute inhalation of C5-PFK gas in mice was 7400-7500ppm (female) and 8600-8800ppm (male). The acute toxicity of C5-PFK gas should be classified as the lowest toxic category 4 in the GHS, which is a low-toxic gas.

articleTitle: Calculation model of aerodynamic parameters for iced wind turbine
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Wind turbines at high altitudes suffer icing harm frequently in winter, and the aerodynamic profile will be destroyed which leads to output power loss. Studying the aerodynamic parameters could provide references in icing prediction or anti-icing. 3D CFD simulation is a common method to solve these issues, but it consumes lots of computational resources and time. In this paper, a more simpler calculation model of aerodynamic parameters for iced wind turbine, which combining 2D CFD simulation method and blade element momentum, is proposed. The accuracy of this model is verified by comparing the calculated and measuring output power results. According to this model, axial inducing factor a, tangential inducing factor b, tangential force PN and normal force PT are calculated under different wind velocity as well. The results show that the max factor a appears near rotor tip while the max factor b appears near rotor root. Furthermore, with the increasing of wind velocity, PN and PT show an increasing trend. By comparing the normal force on blade under icing and clean condition, results show that, with wind velocity increasing, the difference of normal force will get larger and the max difference appears near the rotor tip.

articleTitle: First principle study of charge transport properties in silicone rubber based on classical marcus theory
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The aging and even electrical breakdown of polymer insulating material is strongly related to the charge transport process under high electric field. But our knowledge of the charge transport mechanism of polymer insulation is still lacking. Recently, the hole transfer process in polyethylene (PE) was described successfully by Marcus theory, which is a classical method applied to characteristic the carrier transport in organic semiconductors previously. To clarify if Marcus theory is suitable for other types of insulating material with more complex structures than PE, the Marcus parameters of the silicone rubber materials with four different side chain groups were calculated and compared by first principle method. All calculation results indicated that the charge transport in silicone rubber belongs to hopping mechanism due to larger reorganization and smaller electronic coupling, and Marcus theory could be a good method to evaluate charge transport properties in silicone rubber. Furthermore, different side chain groups of silicone rubber will influence the charge transport properties by changing the frontier molecular orbitals and potential energy surface of SR molecule.

articleTitle: The space charge behaviour in LDPE under AC field with frequency from 1 mHz to 1 kHz
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of space charge accumulation in polymers, it is necessary to study the characteristics of space charge accumulation under different frequencies of electric fields. In this paper, the space charge of low density polyethylene (LDPE) samples under 1 mHz ∼ 1 kHz sinusoidal electric field was measured, and the charge transport characteristics under different frequencies of electric field were analysed. The results showed that the average phase volume charge density ρθ of LDPE varies between 0.1 C/m3 in the frequency range of 1 kHz-50 Hz. In the range of 50 Hz∼1Hz, the charge amount began to increase slightly. When the frequency drops from 1 Hz to 0.1 Hz, the charge accumulation increases sharply. In the range of 0.1 Hz ∼ 1 mHz, the charge accumulation increases slowly. At the same time, from high frequency to low frequency, the heterogeneous charges gathered near the anode and cathode change to homogeneous charges. It is found that the variation of space charge at different frequencies is mainly related to the variation of injected charge. The duration of effective electric field increases at low frequency, resulting in the increase of charge injection. Charge hysteresis occurs in both high and low frequency electric fields, which is closely related to the process of charge capture and release. Through the analysis of electric field distortion rate, it is found that the variation trend of electric field distortion rate is consistent with the variation trend of charge density in samples. The analysis can provide reference for the space charge accumulation in LDPE under AC field.

articleTitle: Research on self-healing characteristics of metallized film capacitor via acoustic and electric combined detection
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Metallized film capacitor is widely used in pulse power generators and HVDC power transmission system. The high reliability of capacitor is mainly beneficial from the self-healing process. With the increase of its operation time and discharge time, frequent self-healing leads to loss of capacitance. Therefore, it is important to develop an effective detection method to monitor the self-healing characteristics of MFC. In this paper, a self-healing detection method based on acoustic and electric combination is proposed for MFC with high sheet resistance and the self-healing ultrasonic signal is analyzed. The influence of pulsed discharge times on the characteristic of self-healing is studied through online self-healing detection method. The results show that peak frequency of ultrasonic signal is between 50 kHz and 60 kHz. As the number of pulsed discharge time increases, low voltage self-healing discharges become more frequent and the self-healing frequency has same increasing trend with capacitance loss. When the capacitor is near the end of its life, the self-healing frequency increases sharply and the probability of high-energy self-healing point increases significantly. It's indicated that this detection method has a good application prospect for the monitor of aging state of the capacitor through the change of the self-healing characteristic.

articleTitle: Modelling of initial streamer discharge voltage of C4F7N/CO2 mixed gas considering electrode surface roughness
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The traditional calculation model of streamer initial discharge is simplified and has huge errors from experiment if not considering the effect of actual electrode surface roughness, so it is necessary to improve the calculation model considering the influence of roughness. The main purpose of this paper is to improve the model by considering effect of electrode surface roughness. The power frequency discharge voltage of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixture under different roughness conditions is calculated. It is found that the influence of electrode surface roughness is stronger at higher pressures. Experiments are carried out to verify the model, which provides a reference for calculating the discharge field strength of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixture.

articleTitle: Disc-type motor control based on current prediction
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Because the disc motor has no iron core structure, the stator winding inductance is very small, so that the voltage-type controller passes the current in the winding discontinuously, which generates electromagnetic torque pulsation, which affects the control stability. And under high power conditions, heating is obvious, and the motor parameters will change with changes in temperature or current. Due to the inherent sampling, delay and other factors of traditional PI control, the current loop has a slow response speed and low bandwidth. In order to improve the control performance of the current loop, a control principle based on deadbeat current prediction is proposed. The deadbeat current predictive control increases the current loop bandwidth in principle, and can significantly improve the dynamic performance of the motor. And based on the least square method with forgetting factor, the online identification of motor parameters is realized, and the structure of the current predictive control algorithm based on parameter identification is given. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by the rated 30KW disc-type ironless permanent magnet synchronous motor and the servo control unit, and the simulation and experimental results are analyzed.

articleTitle: Integration of measurement data into condition assessment: a theoretical consideration
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The basis for optimization in asset management of electrical equipment is the availability of condition information. This condition information can be derived by utilizing measurement systems. For an economical viable use in secondary substations, the measurement systems need to have low investment and operating costs. The use of low-cost measurement electronics from the consumer sector results in favourable investment costs for the sensors itself. However, the time and thus costs of installing the sensors need to be considered as well for an economic integration of these measurement systems. In this paper, we analyse cause-effect relationships between component condition and measured variables to identify a minimum set of required measurement variables, which can be measured via non-invasive and easily retrofittable hardware. This analysis shows that condition information for all key components of the secondary substation can be derived from only four measured variables: station temperature, load current, air humidity, and transformer top-tank temperature. Furthermore, a method how to translate measurements to a condition indication utilizing the cause-effect relationships is presented. The condition indications can be used to support maintenance and renewal planning.

articleTitle: Dynamic and quantitative risk assessment of ultra-high voltage converter transformers
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: UHV converter transformers are the pivotal equipment in UHV DC transmission projects, which are characterised by large capacity and high investment costs. The converter transformers can often cause serious losses once a fault occurs. The current AC transformer condition maintenance methods are no longer applicable to converter transformers. In order to avoid equipment failures and reduce risk losses, it is necessary to propose a quantitative risk assessment method that integrates the probability of failure and the consequences of failure to achieve risk management of UHV converter transformers. Based on the analysis of failure modes and characteristic indicators for converter transformers, this paper introduces a risk assessment method that considers multiple indicators, uses a data inversion method to obtain the risk probabilities of equipment components, uses an entropy weighting method to determine the weights of different risks, and presents the proposed risk assessment method in detail through an example. The example shows that the risk assessment method proposed in this paper can give dynamic quantitative risk assessment results based on the set of state characteristic parameters of the UHV converter transformer, which can achieve risk management of the equipment and provide a reference for decision making in operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Research on corona discharge characteristics of DC overhead lines with burr defect based on experiment and numerical simulation
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The burr defect of conductor is an important factor affecting the corona discharge of DC transmission line. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the influence of burr defects on corona discharge characteristics of transmission lines. In this paper, a two-dimensional plasma hybrid mode of the corona space charge distribution of the DC line with the burr defect was established based on the fluid-chemistry kinetics method. The development process of partial discharge was calculated under the conditions of 7 different burr heights between 2 mm-20 mm and 5 different burr tips of curvature radius between 0.1 mm-0.5 mm. The distribution of electric field and space charge near the line and defect and the corona inception voltage of partial discharge under each burr condition in a discharge cycle were obtained. Based on the experiments in a small corona cage, the corona inception voltage, discharge current, UV image and other parameters of positive DC corona discharge of defective line under different environmental factors and defect geometry were obtained. The results show that the electron density and electric field intensity near the tip of the burr are significantly higher than that of the line during the initial process of discharge. With the development of discharge, streamers are generated at the tip of the burr, and the streamers develop along the line between the burr and the negative electrode to the negative electrode. Both the height and tip of burr have influence on the corona voltage and discharge process of the defect line. The higher the burr height and the sharper the burr head are, the lower the corona inception voltage and the more serious the electric field distortion will be, which will do harm to the safe and stable operation of DC lines. The simulation results of corona current and corona inception voltage are consistent with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Electrical stresses simulation of DC cable in ±10 kV distribution system
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: With the rapid development and engineering application of voltage source converters (VSC) technology, high-voltage DC cable technology has developed rapidly in the past two decades, the voltage of extruded insulation DC cables based on cross-linked polyethylene ranges from 80kV to 640kV. Due to the engineering demand of a medium voltage distribution system, the research on medium voltage DC (MVDC) cables is not very advanced. At present, the DC distribution system is an important development direction in the energy transmission sector. In order to provide a reference for an MVDC cable design, it is necessary to carry out related research on the electrical stress on MVDC cables used in a medium voltage distribution system. Based on the simplified topological structure of the distribution system, in this paper a model of an MVDC distribution system is presented and used to simulate typical faults to preliminarily determine the switching impulse voltage and lighting impulse voltage of an MVDC cable in the MVDC distribution system.

articleTitle: Role of energy and gas pressure on phase evolution of nano-alumina in wire explosion process
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Phase control of alumina nanoparticles (NPs) is successfully shown by wire explosion process under gas ambient. Aluminium wire was exploded at different levels of energy in oxygen ambient under pressures of 20 and 180 kPa. X-ray diffraction patterns indicate that the 20 kPa tests yield δ-alumina while 180 kPa tests yield γ-alumina NPs with an appropriate value of energy. Spherical NPs were obtained as visualised from SEM and TEM micrographs. Size of NPs decreased with an increase in energy and/or a decrease in pressure of oxygen. The formation mechanism of different phases and sizes of NPs are detailed in this paper.

articleTitle: Testing research on AC interference of UHV AC gil test line to buried metal pipeline
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: There may be circulating current in a GIL system through vertical ground wires, grounding grids, and enclosure. In addition, there may also be abnormal conditions such as equipment fault. These will cause AC interference to the buried underground pipelines nearby. Based on electrified examination for the UHV AC GIL test line, buried metal pipelines were laid in parallel near GIL, and the test platform of GIL for AC interference to buried pipelines was built. The on-site pipelines, monitoring coupons, test piles, and reference electrodes were buried. The effect of enclosure leakage current on the electrochemical corrosion of adjacent metal pipelines during GIL's long-term operation was investigated. The various parameters were on-site measured at intervals. The test results show that: after the current is applied to GIL, AC interference occurs in the pipeline and soil. Before and after the current was applied to GIL, the pipeline to ground potential has almost no change. The corrosion degree of buried coupons is very slight. Generally, the degree of AC interference is very slight and can be almost ignored.

articleTitle: Thermal ageing of cross-linked polyethylene cables: mechanism and influence on the time-varying property of frequency domain dielectric spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In this work, samples of cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cables are subjected to accelerated thermal ageing experiments, and the frequency domain dielectric spectroscopy (FDS) test is performed to evaluate the ageing status of XLPE cables accurately on the basis of dielectric characteristics. The FDS results of samples subjected to accelerated thermal ageing experiments at three different temperatures illustrate that dielectric loss does not monotonously increase with the passage of thermal ageing. Instead, dielectric loss first increases, then decreases and finally increases. The results of samples from cables operated for years are in good agreement with those of the former samples. Further study shows that the change in dielectric loss can be mainly attributed to the partial melting of the imperfect crystals in XLPE, the subsequent process of recrystallisation and the process of molecular chain breakage. On the basis of the above results, the rise in the dielectric loss spectrum does not necessarily indicate that XLPE has entered the later stage of ageing. The historical data of FDS tests are necessary to obtain an objective judgement of the ageing state of XLPE cables.

articleTitle: Experimental study on thrust and thrust to power ratio of graphene-coated wire-airfoil electrodes for ionic wind propulsion
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Since electrical discharges were found to induce gas flows since 1709, numerous studies on ionic wind thrust and its application has been carried out. Ionic wind propulsion device can be applied to the propulsion of micro aircraft and expected to become a new aviation propulsion method, due to its advantages such as no moving parts, low working noise and no greenhouse gas emission. Thrust and thrust to power ratio (T/P) are two important performance indicators of ionic wind propulsion device. At present, the influences of electrode shape and size, electrode spacing and array structure on thrust and T/P have been investigated, but the influence of electrode coating material has been rarely studied. Previous studies have shown that graphene coating on the electrode surface has influence on the corona inception voltage and the current density, but lacking of graphene-coated electrodes on thrust and T/P. In this work, a graphene-coated wire-airfoil electrode array is prepared. The effects of the graphene-coated wire electrode, the graphene-coated airfoil electrode on the thrust and the T/P have been investigated. The experiment results show that graphene-coated wire electrode increases thrust and T/P by a maximum proportion of 39% and 35%, respectively. However, graphene-coated airfoil electrode reduces thrust and T/P by a maximum proportion of 13% and 14%, respectively. The analysis shows that for negative corona discharges, the graphenecoated wire electrode contributes to a lower corona inception voltage and field emission electrons from the graphene surface, while the graphene-coated airfoil electrode generates a reversed ionic wind which reduce the thrust and T/P. This experiment lays a foundation for the subsequent optimization of ionic wind propulsion system.

articleTitle: Research on space charge characteristics and electric threshold of high doping rate epoxy/micro-AL2O3 composites used for GIL basin insulators
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: High doping rate epoxy-alumina Composites serve as the main material of GIL basin insulator due to its excellent electrical, mechanical properties and low price. At present, studies mainly focus on epoxy-based micro/nano doped composites with small doping rates, while in engineering practice the doping rate of GIL basin insulators can be up to 200%-300%. This paper studies the space charge characteristics and electrical threshold of EP(epoxy)/micro-AL<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> composites which contains 200% doping rate of micron alumina. Space charge behaviours under different electric fields and various temperatures are studied. Besides, the space charge injection threshold was measured, followed by analysis on high electric field space charge generation and dissipation characteristics. It is found that the charge injection threshold has a certain relationship with temperature, and its magnitude is approximately linear with the reciprocal of temperature. In addition, epoxy doped with 200% of micro alumina showed higher space charge threshold compared with pure epoxy, suggesting better charge suppression abilities. The results of this paper reveal the space charge characteristics of EP/micro-AL<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> composites with high doping rate, which has great guiding significance for the study on mechanism of aging and insulation failure of GIL basin insulators in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Study on dielectric and discharge characteristics of nano-Al2O3 modified insulating paperboard under AC-DC combined voltage
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The oil-paper insulation system on the valve side of the converter transformer works under complex electrical stress for a long time, which are prone to insulation problems. With the current in-depth research on nanocomposite materials, it has become a feasible method to improve the insulation performance of paperboard through nano-modification. In view of the above problems, firstly, modified insulating paperboards containing different concentrations of nano-Al2O3 were prepared, and the changes of parameters such as relative permittivity, volume resistivity and dielectric loss tangent of oil-impregnated paperboard with doping concentration were studied. Subsequently, the breakdown experiments of the modified insulating paperboard under AC and AC-DC combined voltage were carried out. The study shows that the doping of nano-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> can effectively reduce the relative permittivity and dielectric loss of the insulating paperboard, and improve the volume resistivity of the insulating paperboard to a certain extent. With the increase of the doping ratio of nano-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> particles, the breakdown strength of the insulating paperboard first increase and then decrease. Finally, the optimal doping concentration under different DC components is obtained. This work is of great significance to the optimization of converter transformer insulation and the application and promotion of modified paperboard under complex electric fields.

articleTitle: Study about anti-icing effect of weatherproof super-hydrophobic coating on wind turbine
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In the regions with low temperature and high humidity, ice on the blades affects the safety and efficient operation of wind turbines seriously. The large static contact angle and low rolling angle properties of super-hydrophobic coating can effectively delay the icing process on wind turbine blades. However, low temperature, high humidity and flow crash limit the large-scale application of super-hydrophobic coating on operating wind turbines. In this paper, one kind of weatherproof super-hydrophobic coating produced by self-assembly precipitation method is proposed, with wear-resistance, acid- and alkali-resistance properties tested. Results show that the coating has good wear-resistance, acid-resistance and alkali-resistance properties, and the coating has a certain retardation effect on glaze and mixed ice during the inception of icing.

articleTitle: Research on absorption spectrum characteristics of transforemer oil
