abstract: In this paper, a mathematical model of photovoltaic power station is established in the EMTP environment to present the distribution of induced voltage on photovoltaic panels caused by lightning strikes on high buildings. The transient calculation results proves that, when lightning strikes the lightning rod of a photovoltaic power station or other towering buildings, the lightning current passes through the soil to the grounding system of the photovoltaic panel frame, which can generate a higher overvoltage on the photovoltaic panel and its frame, on the order of kilovolts. Therefore, to limit this overvoltage, this work proposes feasible lightning protection measures for the overvoltage problem. The installation of lightning arresters is one of the most common measures to protect electrical equipment from overvoltage hazards. In addition, another measure is to reduce the grounding resistance and artificially reduce the soil resistivity, thereby reducing the damage of the ground potential to the PV equipment insulation. From the simulation results and the VI characteristics of lightning arrester, the transient voltage is limited to reach the BS 60950 standard. The results show that the correct lightning protection measures will help reduce the damage of lightning strikes to the PV system.

articleTitle: Application of microstrip filter for multiple narrow band antenna to detection of partial discharge
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The ultra-high frequency (UHF) antennas are used as sensors to detect electromagnetic (EM) waves emitted from partial discharge (PD) in the high voltage insulation diagnostic field. However, the UHF band includes many communication and broadcasting frequencies, such as cellular phones and Wi-Fi. The authors have developed a multiple narrow-band antenna (MNB) to detect PD signal in the UHF band without radio communication noise that corresponds to several narrowband frequencies used for mobile phones and Wi-Fi. This study proposed the filtered multiple narrow band (FMNB) antenna, which consists of a multiple-strip monopole antenna and microstrip low pass filter (LPF, f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub>=2GHz) on an FR-4 substrate. The microstrip LPF improves the reduction of high-frequency noises without antenna size extension, especially 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi noise. The FMNB antenna was applied to detect the PD in SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas under the Wi-Fi noise emitted from a commercial drone and compared with a standard Horn antenna (HA), one of the high sensitivity wide-band antenna. The experimental results demonstrate that the FMNB antenna is suitable for PD detection in the UHF method under noisy conditions.

articleTitle: Improvement of interface adhesion property of contaminated rtv silicone rubber by plasma jet
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Room Temperature Vulcanized (RTV) Silicone Rubber is widely used in electrical power system to improve insulation performance of the porcelain insulator and glass insulator. After long-time running, RTV coatings get contaminated, aged, and even peel off, needing to be recoated. The inorganic contaminants accumulate and embed into the original RTV coating, causing adverse effect on the recoating process. In this article, plasma treatment was used to process contaminated RTV coating while the contaminants were not removed. Water boiling test and swelling test were used to evaluate interfacial adhesion properties. Microscopic morphology and internal structure of recoating interface were studied by Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and Computed tomography (CT). The chemical functional groups and element composition were studied by Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). After plasma treatment, the blister area and peeling area on the samples during water boiling test and swelling test became smaller. Microscopic experiments show that the boundary of recoating interface became less clear, the number of voids at the interface decreased, more low molecular weight siloxanes accelerated to the contaminated layer and silicon atoms were bonded to more oxygen atoms, indicating that plasma treatment can improve the adhesion properties of contaminated RTV.

articleTitle: Research on insulation failure characteristics of encapsulated insulating resin under impulse electric
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The leapfrog development of wide-bandgap semiconductor technology breaks through the theoretical limit of traditional silicon-based devices: the volume of the device is reduced by an order of magnitude, the operating voltage, breaking frequency ,and power density are increased by one to several orders, and the semiconductor module is carried in a smaller scale. Higher-density electromagnetic energy exceeds the long-term endurance limit of the packaging insulating resin, and the premature failure of insulating materials under complex electrothermal coupling stress has become the primary bottleneck restricting the improvement of device performance and threatening the safety of equipment in service. In this paper, based on the actual operating environment of the packaged insulating resin, a platform for insulation failure under a pulsed electric field was built, and an electrical tree test under a pulsed electric field was carried out. The law of insulation failure of the silicone gel was obtained. The experiment found that the tree rise time varies with the increase of voltage or frequency. The exponential law decreases; the fractal dimension of electrical tree branches linearly increases with the increase of frequency. When the frequency changes in the range of 5k~10kHz, the fractal dimension of silicone gel electrical tree branches changes from 1.6 to 1.91.

articleTitle: Simulation study of space charge behavior characteristics in xlpe cable insulation under alternating current field
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The behavior of space charges is one of the important reasons for the initiation of electric tree in crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) cable under alternating current (AC) field. In this paper, in order to explore the space charge behavior characteristics, the bipolar space charge transfer models with asymmetrical parameters are established. The behavior characteristics of space charge such as accumulation, trapping, de-trapping and recombination are studied. In order to further explore the mechanism of the behaviors of space charge, the net charges are separated to study the charge density distribution of free electrons, free holes, trapped electrons and trapped holes respectively. It is found that the positive charges accumulate near the electrode interface while the negative charges accumulate deep in the material. The recombination behavior of space charges is most active and the recombination of trapped charges is the main one. The density of trapped charges is much higher than that of free charges and trapped charges are the main participant in the dynamic behavior of space charges. This study provides a theoretical foundation for reducing charge accumulation and electrical tree fault.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis model of DGA in transformer and reactor oil based on time series feature analysis
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: When DGA online device is introduced into transformer/reactor monitoring, the traditional online monitoring data will produce some problems such as insufficient accuracy of measurement errors. Considering the error generated during the actual operation of the online monitoring device, this paper proposes a sliding time interval sampling sequence that is different from the conventional point sampling, and analyses the trend characteristics of data fluctuation in the sampling interval and wavelet energy characteristics. Combined with IEC dissolved gas ratio methods, feature extraction is carried out from the online monitoring data of the devices with faults found. The fault library is established, and the particle swarm optimization is used to improve the parameters of the multi-class support vector machine. A fault diagnosis model based on time series feature analysis is proposed, and the traditional IEC oil dissolved gas ratio method and the support vector machine diagnosis method using time point data are compared. The simulation analysis results show that the method proposed in this paper has higher classification accuracy and is more suitable for fault diagnosis of online monitoring data.

articleTitle: Influences of low temperature on velocity of positive streamer under uniform field of air gap
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Characteristics of streamer propagation in psychro-environment are of great theoretical significance. In this paper, we establish a test chamber that can achieve a low temperature environment, and place a three-electrode arrangement platform in the chamber to create a uniform field where the positive streamer propagates forward. Meanwhile, we use PMT and ICCD to detect propagation velocity, and some other properties. The results show that the field required for initial streamer propagation is exponentially based on temperature; the initial streamer velocity decreases linearly with the temperature falling; the growth rate of velocity under increasing field and the dispersion of velocities under the same field decrease as the temperature falls. By reducing the pulse amplitude applied on the conical electrode, the streamer velocities have an overall decrease, and the initial field rises at each temperature. According to the images captured by ICCD, we also have other findings about the variation of streamer morphology under different conditions.

articleTitle: Simulation study of EMU arrester under typical overvoltage
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Electric Multiple Units(EMU) roof arrester can effectively limit all kinds of overvoltage and ensure the safe operation of EMU electrical equipment. In the process of high-speed running, the pantograph catenary is off-line frequently, which will produce overvoltage. The operation of circuit breaker is also an important factor of overvoltage. The roof arrester explosion accidents occur occasionally, so it is necessary to conduct intensive study on the arrester accidents. By analyzing a large number of pantograph voltage waveforms, the abnormal voltage is divided into three categories: over-phase voltage, high harmonic voltage and steep wave impulse overvoltage. The characteristics of abnormal voltage waveforms are summarized. Through the simulation calculation, the current response of the arrester under three kinds of abnormal voltage is obtained. It is proposed that the continuous steep wave impulse voltage is the main reason for the explosion accident of the arrester, which provides the improvement direction for the design and manufacture of the EMU arrester.

articleTitle: Effect of premature crosslinking and thermal oxidation on the breakdown performance of crosslinkable polyethylene insulating materials
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Crosslinkable polyethylene insulation materials is widely used in high-voltage cables. However, premature crosslinking and thermal oxidation in the extrusion process of the insulating materials have a negative impact on the breakdown performance of the cable. In this work, the samples of insulating materials with different degrees of premature crosslinking and thermal oxidation are prepared, and the breakdown performance of insulating materials with and without antioxidants are compared. Gel content, crystallinity and carbonyl index have been obtained through experiments. The results show that the breakdown performance of the insulating materials depends on various factors such as the uniformity of crosslinked network, thermal oxidation, and crystallinity. The increase in defects under the combined effects of uneven premature crosslinking and thermal oxidation is the main cause of the decrease in breakdown strength and the increase in the dispersion of breakdown experimental data. What's more, hindered antioxidants can inhibit premature crosslinking and thermal oxidation, which can improve the breakdown performance of crosslinkable polyethylene insulating materials.

articleTitle: Research on target selection of gateway power transformer error test based on fuzzy decision and combination weighting method
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The measurement accuracy of gateway power transformer is of great significance for the fairness of electricity settle account and power market transaction. The secondary load of transformer is an important factor affecting the error of transformer. Based on the investigation that the actual secondary load of the gateway transformer in many provincial companies is too small, which leads to the error tolerance, in order to promote the planning and development of the domestic gateway power transformer secondary load and error test, In this paper, the primary selection of test target is carried out based on the gateway electricity settle account method. Furthermore, the selection method of test target based on fuzzy decision and combination weighting method is proposed. Through the example analysis, the optimal test target is selected. The results show that the proposed method reduces the subjectivity of test objective decision-making, and solves the problems of uncertainty and fuzziness in the process of test objective selection of gateway power transformer secondary load and error test.

articleTitle: Effect of stereoregularity and grafting monomers on dielectric constant of polypropylene
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Polypropylene is one of the commonly used materials for film capacitors. Increasing the dielectric constant of polypropylene can improve the energy storage density of the capacitor, reduce the volume of power capacitor, and reduce the land occupation cost of electrical equipment. The stereoregularity of polypropylene can be divided into isotactic polypropylene, syndiotactic polypropylene and atactic polypropylene. In addition, the molecular chain of polypropylene can be grafted with acid monomers such as methyl acrylic acid, acrylic acid and maleic anhydride to improve the dielectric constant of polypropylene. Therefore, based on the density functional theory and Clausius-Mosoti equation, the dielectric constants of isotactic polypropylene, syndiotactic polypropylene and atactic polypropylene with the same molecular weight were calculated, and the dielectric constants of the modified molecules were calculated after grafting acid monomers such as acrylic acid on the molecular chain. It provides a theoretical basis for finding the molecular structure to improve the dielectric constant.

articleTitle: Development of a spherical transient electric field measuring instrument based on wreless transmission
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Because of its small size, simple structure and stable parameters, spherical electric field measuring instrument is often used in non-contact measurement of transient voltage. However, the spherical electric field measuring instrument developed in the past is mostly used for steady-state electric field measurement. For most spherical transient electric field measuring instrument, the measured electric field waveform is greatly different from the actual transient voltage waveform. By optimizing the structure design of the electric field sensor and adjusting the matching parameters between the internal sampling capacitance o and the input impedance of the acquisition card, the consistency of waveforms between the electric field measuring instrument and the actual transient voltage waveform is realized. The improved spherical electric field measurement instrument with wireless transmission is calibrated under the approximate uniform electric field, non-uniform electric field and power frequency uniform electric field. The calibration results show that it has good linearity of scale factor. The application of the electric field measuring instrument in the linearity calibration test of impulse voltage divider can solve the problem of lacking standard high voltage impulse voltage divider in the field calibration, and ensure the measurement accuracy of high voltage standard impulse voltage divider in the field test.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling with dynamic characteristics of network for electric thermal integrated energy system
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In order to improve the overall utilization of energy, the concept of integrated energy system (IES) came into being. With CHP as the core unit, IES breaks the original mode of independent operation and is the future strategic development direction of energy system. In this paper, the transmission characteristics of heat supply network are analyzed, and the forward backward algebraic model of heat supply network is established. The first mock exam is that the thermal power system has its unique transmission delay and temperature loss characteristics. A unified model based on the integrated power and heat resources is built. Then, according to this model, an optimal scheduling model of comprehensive energy system, which takes into account the dynamic characteristics of the network, is established to minimize the total operating cost of the electric-thermal system and the related constraints of the power system and the thermal system, and is solved. In the end, this paper uses 30 node power system and 16 node thermal system as examples to optimize scheduling in three cases, to explore the impact of dynamic characteristics on the system, and to prove that considering dynamic characteristics can increase the energy storage of the system and get more real total operation cost and scheduling results.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of pollution level on temperature rise of composite insulators
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: After the pollution on the surface of the composite insulator is wetting, a conductive film is formed, which decreases the surface resistance of the insulator and increases the surface leakage current, thus causing the abnormal temperature rise of the insulator. The heating degree caused by different pollution levels of composite insulators is greatly different. It is of great practical application value to analyze the corresponding relationship between pollution levels and the temperature rise degree of composite insulators. The composite insulator model was established, the load and boundary conditions were consistent with the actual operating conditions, the pollution level was adjusted, multiple simulations were carried out, and the surface temperature of the composite insulator was recorded. In order to verify the reliability of the simulation results, composite insulators with the same conditions were selected for test. By adjusting the pollution level, multiple groups of experiments were conducted to obtain the surface temperature of composite insulators. By analyzing the temperature rise data obtained, the mapping relationship between different pollution levels and the corresponding temperature rise range can be obtained, which provides a theoretical basis for transmission line operation and maintenance personnel to decide whether to replace the composite insulator.

articleTitle: Combining multi-type power optimization to improve the consumption of renewable energy
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In order to promote the consumption of a high proportion of new energy generation in the power system, and realize the maximum peak shaving benefit, economic benefit and environmental protection benefit of wind power, photovoltaic power generation, hydropower generation and thermal power generation multi-energy base joint optimized dispatching, this article is analysing multi-energy. Based on the temporal and spatial characteristics of the medium, a joint optimal dispatch model with the optimization objectives of minimizing the operating cost, abandonment of wind, abandonment of light, and abandonment of water for thermal power plants is proposed, which is a joint optimization dispatch for the sending-end multi-energy base under the background of UHV power transmission. The question provides a reference solution. The calculation example in this article takes the improved IEEE-24 bus as the research object. Through the calculation and analysis of the actual calculation example, it is verified that the model in the article can theoretically promote the consumption of new energy power generation and reduce the operating cost of thermal power units.

articleTitle: Reference calibrator for combined and composite high voltage impulse tests
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: This paper describes the design and characterization of a reference calibrator, able to generate any type of reference wave shape, such as AC, DC, LI, SI, combined, or composite, up to 900 V. This reference calibrator has been developed at the French National Metrology Institute (LNE), using a novel approach, based on a linear high voltage amplifier. For combined and composite wave shapes, there are no reference or commercial calibrators available on the market nor at National Metrology Institutes. This reference calibrator will enable required calibration capabilities to be created to accurately determine the uncertainty in the calibration of combined and composite wave shapes, and fulfil the requirements of the IEC 61083-1 standard. Further experiments have been performed in order to evaluate the calibrator performances, for impulses as fast as LI, as slow as SI, and combined and composite wave shapes, during which LI or SI are superimposed on AC or DC voltages. Furthermore, two methods have been proposed to demonstrate the calibrator traceability to the international system of units, up to 900 V. This study will contribute to the preparation of voltage testing standardization with combined and composite wave shapes for the forthcoming revision of the IEC 61083-1 standard.

articleTitle: Analysis of the relationship between the loss of the three-phase five-limb transformer and GIC
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The transformer core loss increases with the increase of the geomagnetically induced current, so it is of great significance to establish a suitable model to simulate the relationship between the complex power loss of the transformer core and GIC. According to the electromagnetic characteristics of a 220kV dual-winding three-phase five-limb transformer, the loss of the transformer core with DC bias is calculated, and the change law of transformer loss under different degrees of DC bias is summarized. In the developed transformer model, the time-domain differential equation of external circuit is iteratively calculated by Runge-Kutta algorithm. Furthermore, the core loss of a transformer mainly includes hysteresis loss, eddy current loss and stray loss, and all of which are functions of magnetic flux density. By fitting the iron loss curve, the loss calculation parameters are obtained based on the Bertotti iron loss separation model. For the 220kV three-phase five-limb transformer studied in this paper, the loss of the transformer under different geomagnetic induced currents is calculated through finite element analysis, and the relationship between loss and GIC is obtained.

articleTitle: Design of corona aging test device for silicone rubber based on finite element electric field simulation
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Surface discharge is one of the main reasons for silicone rubber aging, and corona discharge is the main form of surface discharge. Based on the finite element method, COMSOL was used to simulate the corona discharge process of silicone rubber. Focus on the relationship between corona inception voltage and electric field modulus of silicone rubber surface under different clearance, the influence of distance between two needle electrodes on the electric field uniformity of silicone rubber. According to the simulation results, a new multi-needles plate electrode corona discharge divice is designed. On the basis of this design scheme, a wider range and more uniform corona can be designed, which provides a new perspective for the study of aging process of silicone rubber.

articleTitle: PD characteristics of epoxy surface triggered by metal particle under AC superimposed lightning impulse in SF6 gas
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Metal particle pollution on the insulation surface will largely reduce the partial discharge inception voltage (PDIV) of the epoxy insulators surface of gas insulated switchgear (GIS). In this paper, the excitation characteristics of the AC PDs on epoxy insulation surface triggered by metal particle has been measured and analyzed under AC superimposed a negative lightning impulse (LI, 1.2/50 μs) in SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas. PDs are measured by three sensors, a 50 Ω measurement impedance, an ultrahigh frequency sensor and a photomultiplier tube. Results show that when the AC voltage is below the PDIV, AC PDs on epoxy insulation surface can be excited by metal particle after applied a negative LI on the negative semi-wave (225 to 360˚). The PDs after the LI voltage is only distributed in the positive half cycle of the AC voltage, which can last for tens of milliseconds after the negative LI.

articleTitle: Application of PD detection technology in withstand voltage test for power cable lines
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Synchronous partial discharge (PD) detection in withstand voltage test of HV cable is an effective means to improve the reliability of handover test. However, it is not easy to ensure the test quality of large-scale distributed PD detection of cable lines. Based on the equivalent circuit analysis of the cable joint and its link-box, it provides some methods more sensitive for installing the local PD sensor than the traditional “HFCT on ground wire” method, such as the capacitor jumper method (HFCT on C-wires). Three kinds of distributed PD detection systems mainly used in withstand voltage tests are introduced: independent distributed, optical fiber communication distributed, and wireless communication distributed. The synchronous PD test of the whole cable line is realized by obtaining the test frequency signal or using the frequency signal generator's frequency signal as the reference standardization phase frequency. The detection sensitivity can be tested and corrected, and the PD pulse wave velocity can be measured and confirmed by injection of the simulated PD signal to ensure the sensitivity of PD detection. The on-site case illustrates how to observe the suspected partial discharge signal, analyze and distinguish the true and false, and evaluate the location of the signal source. The PD signal can be automatically detected by the detection threshold of the signal amplitude, pulse repetition, and duration, identified by the neural network automatic PRPD graph and then confirmed by the signal waveform.

articleTitle: Micro-cantilever electric field sensors based on Piezoelectric-piezoresistive Coupling
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: With the development of the ubiquitous power Internet of Things, online monitoring and status awareness of power systems and equipment has become an important method to ensure the safe operation of the power grid. The measurement of electric fields can be used for fault diagnosis of power equipment such as such as insulator failure. At the same time, by inverting the line voltage through the electric field, wide-area online monitoring of the power system can be achieved. Therefore, miniature electric-field sensors (E-sensors) with high sensitivity and high amplitude are needed. In this paper, we proposed a novel miniature E-sensor with cantilever structure. The proposed E-sensor combines the piezoelectric effect and the piezoresistive effect. Experimental results show that our sensor has a high resolution of 156 V/m and a magnitude of over 1.5 MV/m. Moreover, silicon-based micro-fabrication makes our sensor has low cost and are suitable for mass production, which is suitable for large-scale sensor arrays and wide-area monitoring.

articleTitle: Study on pollution accumulation of different string insulators in the UHVDC transmission line
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In this paper, insulators of ±800kV UHVDC transmission lines in two types of typical climate conditions, namely extreme arid and humid, were taken as the research objects. The natural pollution accumulation tests were carried out to obtain the pollution accumulation characteristics of different string insulators under different climate conditions. The measured results show that the ESDD ratio of V-string composite insulator and I-string porcelain insulator is 0.68 in the extremely arid region, and that of V-string and I-string insulator is 0.72 in the humid region. The research results can provide a basis for the differentiated design of external insulation configuration of UHVDC transmission lines in different environmental areas.

articleTitle: Partial discharge pattern recognition in gis based on s transform denoising
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: With the development of urban power grid construction, the number of gas insulated switchgear (GIS) substations is increasing continuously, the internal space of GIS is very limited, the working field strength is very high, and the insulation margin is relatively small. Once the insulation defect of GIS appears, it is easy to cause equipment failure and lead to huge loss. Therefore, it is essential to detect the partial discharge signals of GIS in operation. In order to improve the recognition accuracy of PD patterns in GIS, a PD pattern recognition method based on S transform denoising was proposed in this paper. Firstly, partial discharge signals of simulated GIS models were collected by ultrasonic method, and then we used the S transform method to filter noise in partial discharge signals, then we extracted the signal statistical characteristics of partial discharge, using kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) to reduce the dimensionality of the extracted statistical features. Support vector machine (SVM) was applied to classify the partial discharge signals in this paper. The experimental results show that the S transform method is more effective than the traditional wavelet method in signal denosing of Bubble discharge, Floating discharge, Tip discharge and Creeping discharge in GIS. Based on the S transform denoising method, the recognition accuracy was higher than 90%.

articleTitle: Effect of the power supply frequency on the mode transition of appj plasma bullet
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The ICCD camera was used to record the discharge development from both front and side direction of the jet tube to study the plasma bullet structure of the atmospheric pressure helium plasma jet with needle-ring electrode configuration under pulsed voltage. The results showed that the plasma “bullet” has a ring-shape structure and the top of the bullet is flat at a relatively low frequency. However, with the increasing of the pulse frequency, the hollow area in the center of plasma plume was gradually filled with a bright red core, and the plasma bullet becomes solid and shows a three-dimensional structure with the centre bulges on the top.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis method of power module for charging pile based on neural network
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The fault rate of power module for electric vehicle charging pile is high and it is difficult to identify and locate the fault. A fault diagnosis method based on neural network is proposed, which provides the necessary reference and premise for the rapid realization of fault state identification and on-site maintenance. Firstly, the two-stage circuit simulation model of power module is built and different open circuit faults are set up to extract the three-phase input current and output voltage signals under fault state. Then the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is used to process the voltage and current signal, and the amplitude of 50 Hz frequency doubling signal is extracted as the fault feature vector. Finally, the identification and location of open circuit fault of power module are realized based on neural network. Simulation and experiment show that this method can effectively realize the fault diagnosis of power module.

articleTitle: Study on the characteristics of bird streamer flashover discharge under DC voltage
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The number of transmission line faults caused by bird activities has increased significantly because of the development of power grid and the improvement of ecological environment. In order to study the flashover of transmission line caused by bird activities, the characteristics of air gap flashover under DC voltage of bird streamers falling in different patterns are studied. The experiment results are as shown below When the bird streamer is in a suspended position, the breakdown voltage under DC condition will first increase and then decrease as the simulated streamer gets farther from the low voltage side. The finite element simulation results show that the presence of the bird streamer will lead to the distortion of the electric field in the space, which would further bring a significant decrease in the breakdown voltage. In terms of its overall trend, the positions with high electric field strength are both ends of the bird streamer in the suspended state.

articleTitle: The online monitoring method of degraded vacuum in high voltage vacuum quick switch with SF6 tank insulation structure based on electromagnetic wave method
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The vacuum interrupter (VI) withstands greater pressure difference in high voltage vacuum quick switch with SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> tank insulation structure, which is more likely to lead to SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas leakage. Therefore, it's of significance to monitor the vacuum degree of the VI online. When the vacuum degree deteriorates, discharges will occur between the contacts and the shield due to the reduction of the insulation property, and the electromagnetic wave will be radiated at the same time. This article realized long-distance and non-contact online monitoring of vacuum degree by receiving and analysing the electromagnetic wave signal. An experimental platform was established, which can use the medium voltage experiment to study the situation under high voltage through simulating the potential difference between the contacts and the shield. It was found that the discharge inception voltage of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> is lower than that of air at low pressure because of its large cross-section and small average free path. After the signal is collected and analysed, the effective characteristic quantities are extracted and input into the support vector machine (SVM) regression prediction model, and the vacuum degree reduction in the interrupter is successfully judged.

articleTitle: Effect of additives on melt viscoelasticity of insulating materials used in high voltage crosslinked polyethylene cables
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Low-density polyethylene (LDPE) is widely used in insulating materials for high voltage (HV) crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) cables and its viscoelastic properties are important factors for the extrusion molding of insulating materials. However, the effect of additives such as crosslinking agent and antioxidant on melt viscoelasticity of LDPE-based insulating materials is not comprehensively studied. In this work, the varieties and content of additives are analyzed by infrared spectrum test. Moreover, the molecular chain structure of different LDPE is measured by gel permeation chromatography. Besides, the influence of additives on melt viscoelasticity of LDPE-based insulating materials is discussed. The results show that additives has plasticizing effect on uncross-linked LDPE-based insulating materials, which reduces the complex viscosity and zero shear viscosity of insulating materials melts. Meanwhile, the storage modulus (G') and loss modulus (G'') also have the same trend. The main reason is that small molecular additives enter into the molecular chain segments of LDPE, which can weaken the interaction force between LDPE molecular chains and change the molecular conformation under the shear action. This study reveals that the reasonable additive formula is beneficial to improving the extrusion molding of LDPE-based insulating materials used in HV XLPE cables.

articleTitle: Research on the developing law of the air-gap discharge in oil-paper insulation by multiple methods
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Air-gap discharge is a typical form of partial discharge within power transformer. It is of great significance to study the developing law of air-gap discharge for enhancing the safe operation level of transformers. This paper established a discharge test platform for the development of air-gap discharge in oil-paper insulation, using high frequency current transformer (HFCT), ultra-high frequency (UHF) sensor and ultrasonic sensor to detect the discharge process simultaneously. The results show that: for different methods, the detecting sensitivity is different. The discharge initial voltage of HFCT is the lowest for air-gap discharge and its signal-to-noise ratio is the highest, while the sensitivity of ultrasonic signal is the lowest among the three methods. For air-gap defect, the process of discharge can be divided into initial discharge stage, fluctuating stage and pre-breakdown stage. In the initial discharge stage, the repetition rate of HFCT, the repetition rate of UHF signal, and the peak value of ultrasonic all increase in varying degrees. After entering the fluctuating stage, the statistics of different signals fluctuate in a certain range, and then increase again until entering the pre-breakdown stage.

articleTitle: Partial discharge characteristics of Nano-TiO2 modified OIP bushing capacitor core based on equal margin design
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Oil-immersed paper (OIP) bushing as the outgoing device is one of the core parts of transformer. Therefore, its insulation performance attaches great importance to the stable operation of transformer. In order to reduce transformer bushing failures caused by oil-paper partial discharge during its operation, this paper intends to improve the insulation performance of the main insulating of the OIP transformer bushing by nano-modification technology, and explore the partial discharge (PD) characteristics of the nano-modified bushing core insulation according to the simulation analysis and experimental test results. In this study, transformer cellulose paper was modified by nano-TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> oil immersed method, and the dielectric parameters were tested. The modified and unmodified OIP transformer bushing core models were established in the finite element simulation software, and the electric field distribution of the models was analysed by using the dielectric parameters measured in experiments. According to the equal margin design of transformer bushing, the unmodified and modified models were constructed, and the PD characteristics of the models were tested by the PD measuring platform. Combined with the simulation and experimental results, the PD performance of nano-TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> modified oil-paper is better than that of unmodified one owing to the improvement of nano-TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> on the dielectric properties and oil-paper insulation structure. The maximum field intensity of Nano-TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> modified for equal margin design model is decreased by 13.7%, and the partial discharge inception voltage (PDIV) is increased by18.1%. The research contributes to improve the operation status and serves as a reference for the optimum insulation design of OIP transformer bushing

articleTitle: Research on impulse response characteristics of capacitor voltage transformer and analysis of influencing factors
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In order to study the transfer characteristic of CVT under transient overvoltage, the equivalent circuit model of CVT under transient overvoltage is established. The broadband impedance characteristics of CVT in the range of 50 Hz ~ 2 MHz are analyzed, and the transfer overvoltage of CVT under impulse voltage with different wave-front time is obtained. The influencing factors of CVT transient overvoltage measurement are analyzed. Secondly, a test platform is built to measure the transfer overvoltage of CVT. The transfer overvoltage of CVT with different rated capacitance and different load impulse voltage with different wave-front time is measured. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the impulse response characteristics of CVT are greatly affected by wave-front time of transient overvoltage, rated capacitance of capacitor and load of CVT. There are many resonance points in the high frequency range for the equivalent circuit model of CVT, which leads to the high frequency oscillation of transfer overvoltage. The shorter the wave-front time of transient overvoltage is, the stronger the transfer overvoltage oscillation is. When the wave-front time reaches 300 μ s or above, the transfer overvoltage oscillation is weakened. For CVT with the same voltage level, when the rated capacitance is larger, the oscillation frequency and amplitude of impulse response overvoltage are higher. The impulse response characteristics under no-load and resistance-inductance load are basically the same, and the oscillation amplitude of impulse response overvoltage decreases under resistive load. Combined with the impulse response characteristics of CVT and fault recording device, the actual overvoltage of the primary side can be estimated, which is of great significance to improve the overvoltage monitoring and prediction of power system.

articleTitle: Lightning transient analysis of distributed power flow controller in 220kV AC transmission line
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: In this paper, the topological structure and operation principle of distributed power flow controller (DPFC) are described based on the application of DPFC in 220kV AC transmission system, and the electromagnetic transient simulation model of DPFC in 220 kV AC transmission system is built. The electromagnetic transient characteristics of DPFC under lightning back-strikes and shielding-failure strikes are simulated and analysed, and the overvoltage and overcurrent levels of the key nodes of DPFC after the lightning strikes are obtained. Under the condition of lightning back-strikes, the DPFC in each phase has obviously overvoltage. Nevertheless, overvoltage and overcurrent will be generated in the DPFC of struck phase when the lightning shielding-failure strikes on the transmission line. Besides, the farther the distance from the lightning strike site to DPFC, the lower the overvoltage level of DPFC.

articleTitle: Compatibility test of gaskets and coatings with ester insulating liquids at elevated temperature
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Compatibility test provides recommendations for different electrical equipment to screen appropriate construction materials in different liquids. However, the unique compatibility evaluation standard, ASTM D3455, focusing on mineral-oil-filled transformers is challenged by newly adopted liquids at higher operation temperature. In this paper, the compatibility test method has been modified at elevated temperature in compliance with the thermal class of insulation system. The compatibility tests have been conducted for four types of gaskets, inner surface coating, coating of silicon steel sheet, and enamelled wire with natural ester, synthetic ester and modified ester. After the 168-h heating process, not only the insulating liquids but also the construction materials were analysed and discussed. The results showed that dielectric dissipation factor, breakdown voltage, interfacial tension and acidity of insulating liquids can be determined as critical parameters to judge compatibility, while kinematic viscosity is not sensitive to potential compatibility risks. In addition, properties of construction materials, mass, volume, hardness, tensile strength and elongation of gaskets, are also critical to determine compatibility. It is necessary to raise the test temperature to the thermal class of the electric insulation system. The study is of great significance for transformer manufacturers to determine appropriate compatible materials with ester liquids.

articleTitle: Particle-in-cell simulation of rebreakdown in post-arc stage for low voltage circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Low-voltage circuit breakers are widely used in power distribution systems. Sometimes the gap between electrodes may breakdown again after the arc is extinguished. In this paper, a 1D3V particle-in-cell/Monte Carlo collisional (PIC/MCC) model is developed to study the re-breakdown in the post-arc hot air gap of low-voltage circuit breakers. The model takes into account the cathode electron thermal emission, secondary electrons, elastic and inelastic collisions between particles and background gas. From the simulation results, the electrons in the early stage of simulation mainly come from the background initial plasma and cathode thermal emission. With the increase of the gap voltage, the density of electrons and ions rises, which leads to the gap re-breakdown. A plasma sheath forms near the cathode, and the electric field in it is obviously distorted. In addition, the influence of different parameters such as electrode temperature, gas pressure, gas temperature, gas composition is studied. With the increase of gas temperature, the breakdown voltage decreases significantly. The increase in cathode temperature and the decrease in gas pressure cause the gap easier to breakdown. When copper vapour is mixed into the gas, the gap is more difficult to breakdown under the same gas temperature and electrode temperature.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of temperature field and electric field of oil-paper insulation nonuniform aging of transformer in operation
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Due to the internal temperature gradient of the in-service power transformer, the oil-paper insulation at different positions in windings has different degrees of aging, resulting in nonuniform aging. In order to explore the influence of non-uniform aging and temperature gradient on the electric field strength of oil-paper insulation, related experiments and tests are designed in this paper. The thermal conductivity and dielectric properties of oil-immersed pressboard and transformer oil with different aging are obtained. According to the measured data, the finite element analysis of the temperature field and electric field of the oil-paper insulation is carried out using simulation software. Both experimental data and simulation results show that the effect of thermal aging on the thermal conductivity of oil-immersed pressboard is negligible, and it does not change the temperature distribution of the model. Because of the coaxial structure of oil-paper insulation, the electric field intensity of the model gradually decreases from the inside to the outside. In the oil-paper insulation structure with the same radius, the electric field strength of oil is always greater than that of oil-immersed pressboard. The existence of temperature gradient and nonuniform aging makes the difference of relative permittivity and conductivity between oil-immersed pressboard and transformer oil increase. Compared with uniform aging, the electric field intensity of the oil-immersed pressboard is reduced in the nonuniform aging, and that of the transformer oil becomes larger. Compared with AC electric field, oil-paper insulation under AC / DC superposition electric field is more affected by nonuniform aging and temperature gradient distribution.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic transient simulation analysis on electrical fault of vacuum type on-load tap changer in converter transformer
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: The on-load tap changer (OLTC) is the only moving part of the converter transformer, which plays an important role in compensating the fluctuation of AC voltage in HVDC transmission. However, various mechanical and electrical faults such as vacuum bubble vacuum drop, internal transfer switch burning and protection gap breakdown are easy to occur in the application process of vacuum OLTC. Taking the resistance-type vacuum OLTC which is widely used in engineering as an example, this paper studies the internal electrical characteristics based on the analysis of its structure and working principle, and deduces the calculation formula of recovery voltage and current. The simulation model of switch electrical circuit is established by using PSCAD software. The arc characteristics under normal condition are simulated and analyzed. On the basis of this, the variation of the electric parameter of the tap switch is analyzed when the common faults such as vacuum bubble arc extinguishing failure and mechanical structure loosening. The simulation results show that OLTC will have obvious electrical changes under fault conditions, which will lead to more serious electrical faults. The research in this paper provides reference for the design and fault diagnosis of OLTC in practical DC engineering.

articleTitle: Research on transformer electrodynamic force of 750kV micro-loss economical fault current limiter under power frequency short-circuit
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Economical fault current limiter based on conventional electrical equipment is the first choice to solve the problem of fault current limiting. Under the action of the first half wave of short-circuit current, the electrodynamic force analysis of the transformer winding is the key problem in its design and manufacture. In this paper, the finite element method is used to study the electrodynamic force of transformer winding in the first half wave of short circuit current. Firstly, we can obtain the distribution of magnetic field and leakage magnetic field of the model from the simulation calculation. Then, the magnetic field results are used to calculate the electrodynamic force on the transformer winding, and the results show that the positions with greater force are the end winding and the middle winding respectively. Finally, we use the fine model of the end winding and the middle winding, considering the influence of the blocks and stays. And the distribution characteristics of the maximum stress and the maximum displacement of the two parts under the short-circuit force are analyzed. The research results of this paper will provide an important reference for the design and manufacture of 750 kV economical fault current limiter.

articleTitle: Influence of electrode configuration in simulated lightning strike test
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: An authentic representation of the direct damage effects inflicted by lightning is a key consideration in the safety certification for lightning-prone objects. Our previous research has shown the electrode configuration has a significant influence on the damage results of materials in laboratory lightning testing. While the reason is still not fully understood as the parameters of the short-gap arc discharge are unable to measure with acceptable accuracy. In this study, we study the influence of electrode configurations on the characteristics of lightning arc and the damage response of the test material with a numerical model and experiment. The plasma temperature, current density, velocity, and pressure within arc discharge, as well as the ablation responses of material, are quantitatively discussed in conditions of different electrode configurations. Results show that, when an electrode with a smaller curvature radius is applied in the model, a higher temperature rise and current density occurs. This leads to the phenomenon that the arc root tends to be more localized. On the other hand, in case of adopting an ellipsoidal electrode, the pressure induced by the thermal plasma reaches the minimum value.

articleTitle: Research on the influence factors of dominant frequency of switching overvoltage along power cables
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Power cables have been used in both transmission and distribution networks. To improve the accuracy of the cable parameters calculation during the simulation in electro-magnetic transients program (EMTP), it is important to obtain the dominant frequency of switching overvoltage so that the real situation can be considered. Thus, this presentation mainly focused on the dominant frequency characteristics of switching overvoltage. In the first part, modal circuits of power cables, i.e. the pipereturn mode and the inter-conductor mode, are established in EMTP. By comparing the dominant frequencies of mode voltage and transient overvoltage, it is obtained that the pipe-return mode is the dominant mode of transient overvoltage. Further, based on the calculation of the dominant frequency, the influence of modal-circuit parameters on the frequency characteristics can be derived. Per unit length line parameters, i.e. capacitance and inductance of modal circuit, are affected by the thickness of the main insulation layer, which are determined by the type of cable, i.e. the cross-section area. The research of this presentation has important reference values on clarifying the dominant frequency characteristics and improving the accuracy of cable parameters calculation.

articleTitle: Discharge development in air during lightning impulse stress in uniform electric field with rodshaped protrusion
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Technical air (80 % N2/20 % O2) is an ecologically friendly insulating medium suitable for gas insulated switchgear (GIS). The discharge development in technical air was investigated at 0.1 MPa, 0.3 MPa and 0.5 MPa in a plate-plate electrode arrangement with 100 mm spacing, distorted by a 15 mm long rod shaped protrusion during lightning impulse (LI) voltage stress of positive polarity. Photomultipliers with distinct narrow spectral sensitivities supplemented the voltage and current measurement. From the experiments, three distinct discharge types can be identified. Type 1 discharges are streamer discharges involving a secondary streamer. Discharge types 2 and 3 are related to the leader type channel phenomena. According to the experimental results, leader type channels seem to be highly conductive. The light emission in narrow IR spectral ranges related to the leader type channel indicate thermal dissociation of oxygen and nitrogen molecules. Therefore, leader type channels show similar characteristics that describe a leader channel in SF6. From the time resolved signals, approximated values for the streamer stability field strength Es were determined at 0.3 MPa and 0.5 MPa. The approximated values show that the stability field strength Es varies with the pressure to the power of 1.5 for pressures up to 0.5 MPa.

articleTitle: Enabling a lipp system for space charge measurements under the influence of temperature gradients
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Accumulation of space charges (SC) locally lead to electric field enhancements in polymeric insulators which can eventually cause damage and breakdown. Especially in the design process of cables and components for high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission it is crucial to understand how the composition of insulation materials correspond with SC activity during grid operation. The laser induce pressure pulse (LIPP) system at the TU Berlin's Department for High Voltage Engineering is capable of measuring SC in polymeric planar samples. This paper gives insight into enabling the existing LIPP system to measure SC under the regime of a temperature gradient emulating real-world temperature distributions in HVDC cables and accessories. Therefore, a redesign and upgrade of the measuring cell of the LIPP system has been carried out aided by thermal simulations and verifying temperature measurements of the temperature distribution in the electrode configuration. To ensure the operability of the full scale LIPP system, exemplary SC measurements were conducted under the influence of isothermal and gradient temperature distributions. SC measurements were taken on 0.55 mm planar silicone samples in a temperature spectrum of 20 to 70 °C at an electric field strength of 11 kV/mm.

articleTitle: Influence of type, content and degassing time of crosslinking agent on electrical tree characteristics of XLPE in high voltage cables
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: During the cross-linking process of crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE), cross-linking byproducts are produced, which can cause the distortion of electrical field strength in insulating materials. In this paper, the electrical tree growth characteristics of XLPE cross-linked by different kinds of cross-linking agent and different content of cross-linking agent under AC voltage were studied, and the effect of degassing treatment on the electrical tree characteristics of XLPE insulation was explored. For dicumyl peroxide (DCP) and Bis(tert-butylperoxy) (BIPB) with the same content, the growth rate of electrical tree of XLPE insulation with BIPB is slower than that with DCP. With the increase of cross-linking agent content, the growth rate of electrical tree and the length of electrical tree of XLPE samples decrease first and then increase. Degassing treatment for 48 hours can effectively reduce the cross-linking by-products and improve the electrical tree resistance of XLPE.

articleTitle: Experiment and simulation of high current temperature rise of valve hall fittings
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Value hall fittings play an important role in electrical connection and mechanical fixing. Fittings usually work under large current, so it is necessary to pay attention to its temperature rise. Fittings' shape, material and the environment will affect its temperature rise. In order to study the temperature rise characteristics of fittings, high-current temperature rise experiment were carried out on fittings of different types and materials at different altitudes. In addition, convective heat transfer coefficients between fittings and surrounding environment at different altitudes are derived. The finite element calculation model of fittings is established, and the temperature rise of fittings is simulated by COMSOL Multiphysics. The steady temperature field distribution of fittings at different altitudes is obtained, and the results are compared with the experimental results, which verified the correctness of the theoretical analysis and simulation settings. Finally, the temperature rise of fittings at different altitudes is predicted. This paper can provide reference for material selection and numerical simulation of valve hall fittings in converter stations at different altitudes.

articleTitle: Transient analysis of lightning strike to wind-pv hybrid system
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Numerous wind-PV (Photovoltaic) hybrid systems have been built to make use of renewable energy and reduce carbon emission. A Wind-PV hybrid system operates in open regions and has a large lightning exposure area. When a wind-PV hybrid system is encountered with lightning, the intense transient lightning current is injected into the hybrid system and the equipment might be damaged by the overvoltage inevitably. In this work, a comprehensive model of the hybrid system is built in PSCAD. The transient overvoltage of hybrid system is calculated and analysed, and the influence of different lightning location and different cable length on the overvoltage distribution of hybrid system is studied. The results show that the peak value of transient overvoltage occurs near the lightning strike point, and other systems outside the lightning strike point are little affected by transient overvoltage. Different length of wind farm cable will affect the overvoltage at PV farm and BESS.

articleTitle: A parallel galerkin's moment based method for finding resistance of HVDC grounding electrode
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: High Voltage Direct Current transmission has been used for transmitting a large amount of electric power over long distances. Among different modes of HVDC operation, mono polar and homopolar HVDC operations require ground as the return path. Hence accurate estimation of grounding resistance is a key design aspect in those HVDC operations. The main objective of the present work is to formulate a method for computing the grounding electrode's resistance on uniform soil using Galerkin method of moments. Both testing and basis functions are taken as pulse function instead of a delta function, which makes the method variational and results in a very small error with a substantial saving in computation effort. The effect of air-soil interface is modelled by using the method of images. The resistance of some of the commonly used grounding electrodes in HVDC operation such as star, ring and vertically driven rod are evaluated using the present method. The system matrix is then computed and processed in parallel and solved using parallel conjugate gradient method to make the algorithm efficient in time. The accuracy of the present method and improvement of time efficiency in parallel processing compared to sequential processing is also discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: Study on the parameter evaluation of dielectric relaxation and electric conduction for the thermal aged xlpe cables by DCIC-Q(T) method
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: This paper focuses on the evaluation of dielectric relaxation and electric conduction of XLPE insulation by using a new diagnosis technique-direct current integrated charge (DCIC-Q(t)) method. Thermal aged full-sized cables were studied under different voltages with a long duration time. The selected time benefits to distinguish the relaxation and conduction processes from charge carrier transports. Relaxation time τ of different aged cables are calculated by the analysis of space charges and conduction charges from measurements. Through comparison of charge ratio k and τ, the determination of relaxation by space charges and conduction behaviours can be obtained. The results pointed out that the measured charges increase with the time, especially for high voltage measurements (4 kV and 6 kV). Dielectric relaxation plays an important role in the slight increase of charges within 1000 s. While, charge injection and conduction can lead to the obvious increase of charges under high voltages after 1000 s. In addition, the τ decreases with the increase in voltage. Severe thermal aged cables present a high charge ratio k, permittivity and conductivity. However, the mild aged cables indicate a slight decrease of high charge ratio k, permittivity and conductivity. The measurements and analysis of charges under long time are of importance for dielectric parameter and aging evaluation of XLPE cables.

articleTitle: Influence of SF6 gas mixture ratio in SF6/Dry air mixtures on detection properties of PD-emitted lectromagnetic wave with UHF and VHF band antennas
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: This paper deals with influences of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas mixture ratio on detection properties of partial discharge (PD)-emitted electromagnetic (EM) wave in the SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/dry air mixtures with the UHF and the VHF antennas in view of future diagnostic technology for gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) with new SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> alternatives like C4-Fluoronitrile (C4-FN), C5-Fluoroketone (C5-KF) or CF3I gases used as an electronegative gas. The aim of this study is to clarify whether the UHF method for PD measurements is applicable in the new SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> alternatives like the case in SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>.The authors selected SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/dry air mixtures instead of such as C4-FN/dry air and C5-FN/dry air due to the difficulties of the safe handling of the gas mixtures in the university laboratory. As a basic research, properties of PD-emitted EM waves in SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/dry air mixtures were investigated by changing the SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> contents between 0 % and 30 %, as well as by using two different types of antennas for UHF and VHF bands.

articleTitle: Research on oil-paper insulation charac-teristics under nonuniform electric field
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Converter transformers are key equipment in High Voltage Direct Current(HVDC) power system, while its insulation is an important issue that restricts its safety and reliability. Oil-paper insulation is the most widely used as insulating materials for converter transformers. The increase of local field strength is one of the common fault states in converter transformers, which will cause the dielectric properties of oil-paper insulation to change and cause insulation failure. In order to clarify the rela-tionship between the change of the dielectric properties of oil-paper insulation and the breakdown performance under the con-dition of increased local field strength, the electric (corona discharge) and thermal (130˚C) aging system for oil-paper insula-tion was built in this paper, and analysed the change of oil-paper insulation performance under different electric field distribu-tions. In addition, the relationship between the breakdown strength of oil-paper insulation after aging and the change of char-acteristic quantities such as dielectric constant is discussed from the aspect of mechanism. It is found that under the operating state of nonuniform electric field distribution, the dielectric constant and loss factor of the insulating paper will fluctuate sig-nificantly in the low frequency range where the local field strength is high. At the same time, the insulating paper quickly cracks, Causing the breakdown performance of the insulating paper to rapidly decrease. The research results in this paper are helpful for revealing the breakdown mechanism of oil-paper insulation and for the safe operation of converter transformers under working conditions.

articleTitle: Signal characteristics of transient earth voltage sensor installed inside and outside switch cabinet
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Switch cabinet is one of the most important electrical equipment in power distribution system and its operation safety is related to the power supply reliability. Partial discharge (PD) inside the switch cabinet seriously endangers the normal operation of the distribution system. At present, transient earth voltage (TEV) detection technology has been proved to be convenient, reliable and cost-effective in PD detection and evaluating insulation condition within switch cabinet. TEV sensor used in PD detection is usually mounted on the outside surface or inside surface of the switch cabinet. The PD detection is realized by TVE sensor sensing the TEV signal at its position based on electromagnetic wave propagation behaviors stimulated by PD. Therefore, signal output characteristics will be different because TEV sensor installed inside and outside switch cabinet which will affect the detection sensitivity. This paper focuses on the signal characteristics of TEV sensor installed inside and outside switch cabinet. Firstly, the time dependent electromagnetic wave propagation behaviors are simulated for a switch cabinet using COMSOL Multiphysics. The TEV signal amplitude and arrival time of the TEV sensors installed at different locations are calculated. Then the resulting difference influence of different installation locations on the TEV sensor signals is presented and discussed. The result in this paper is conducive to understanding the optimization of TEV sensor positions for PD detection.

articleTitle: Research on the selection of anti-galloping interphase spacers
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Transmission line galloping is an important issue that threatens the safe operation of the power grid. In the past decade, several line galloping events have occurred in Shandong power grid in 2011, 2016 and 2019, respectively. In this paper, for typical transmission line ice damage events on 220 kV and 500 kV transmission lines in Shandong power grid, comprehensive environmental meteorological information analysis, fault recording and field research are conducted to analyze the causes of transmission line galloping occurrence and give the impact of wind excitation, wire over-icing, line structure and other parameters on typical line galloping. Combined with the actual line galloping management measures and operational performance, the advantages and disadvantages of different types of anti-galloping interphase spacers are given, and the selection recommendations related to anti-galloping interphase spacers are summarized.

articleTitle: The natural concentration gradient distribution of zno- epoxy composites in preparation
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Epoxy resin is a kind of insulation material with excellent electrical and mechanical properties. It is possible to synthesize adaptive materials suitable for crucial applications by adding Zinc oxide (ZnO) microspheres with nonlinear conductance into epoxy resin. There are researches on the mechanism of this kind of polymer, but few researches about the effect of preparation on its performance. In this paper, the distribution of natural concentration gradient in the preparation of ZnO epoxy polymer was investigated. Kiethley-2410c, Scanning Electrical Microscope (SEM) and Thermo Gravimetric Analyzer (TGA) were used to characterize the conductivity, fracture surface appearance and doping concentration of each sample. The results showed that due to the natural sedimentation during the curing process, the concentration gradient appeared in the prepared samples. The volume fractions of ZnO in the vertical sampling were 24.65%, 28.52%, 44.51% and 52.72%, respectively.

articleTitle: Partial discharge characteristics of HVDC cables based on XLPE/EPDM samples and typical artificial defectes
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) detection is an important method to evaluate the operating status of electrical equipment. However, partial discharge pattern recognition technology of XLPE DC cables is currently considered to be in its infancy. According to the common insulation defects and partial discharge characteristics of XLPE cables, four typical defect types are designed in the paper. The XLPE/EPDM samples are designed to simulate the insulation of the DC cable accessories at different locations. The PD are induced by applying a DC voltage to the xlpe/epdm sample. The experimental results show that the development stage of partial discharge in DC cable accessories can be divided into three stages according to the median discharge volume. The median discharge volume in the initial stage of partial discharge changes slowly. The median discharge volume during the development stage of partial discharge has increased sharply. The median discharge volume in the severe stage of partial discharge began to drop. The median discharge volume in the initial stage of partial discharge changes slowly. The discharge amplitude and discharge repetition rate are both small in the initial stage. The median discharge volume during the development stage of partial discharge has increased sharply. In the development stage, the discharge is intense in a very short time, and then the discharge is maintained at a low level. The median discharge volume in the severe stage of partial discharge began to drop. In the severe stage, intensive large-area discharge occurs, and the discharge repetition rate increases significantly. The discharge under the positive voltage is larger than the discharge under the negative voltage at the same conditions.

articleTitle: Transformer internal electromagnetic field distribution and its internal sensor arrangement scheme
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: With the construction of smart grid, a large number of sensors are used in power equipment, and the electromagnetic compatibility of sensors has gradually become prominent. This paper takes a 10 kV three-phase distribution transformer as the research object. A transformer simulation model is established and internal electromagnetic field of the transformer is solved using finite element method. The result intuitively shows the distribution of the electromagnetic field inside the transformer. The maximum internal electric field of the transformer can reach 21.2 kV/cm; the minimum electric field is about 0, which is at the center of the top of the iron core. The maximum internal magnetic field of the transformer can reach 1.5 T, which is located inside the iron core, and the minimum magnetic field is about 0.7 mT, which is located at 1/10 from the side edge of the iron core. Finally, the sensor arrangement scheme inside the transformer is determined based on the simulation results.

articleTitle: Molecular dynamics simulation of electrical properties and surface binding energy of PVDF/ BNNS composites based on ReaxFF
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
abstract: Dielectric capacitor is an efficient energy storage and conversion device. In order to adapt to the operation environment of high voltage, high temperature and other extreme impact, energy storage dielectric materials with excellent properties is required. Polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) has good high temperature resistance and dielectric properties, while boron nitride nanosheet (BNNS) has high breakdown field strength and good thermal conductivity, which is an ideal reinforced body for composite material. In this paper, PVDF was taken as the matrix, by doping different mass fraction of BNNS, PVDF matrix and different doping ratio of PVDF/BNNS composite model were built respectively. The dielectric constant and breakdown strength of each model were calculated and analyzed at different temperatures. The surface binding energy at the junction of PVDF and BNNS was calculated, so as to reveal and the micro-mechanism of doping process from the perspective of energy. The results showed that, doping BNNS in PVDF can indeed improve the energy storage performance of the composites under high temperature conditions. This study provides a theoretical basis for improving the energy storage performance of PVDF material and developing dielectric energy storage materials for high temperature applications.

articleTitle: Research on a new fiber bragg grating partial discharge sensor based on coupling cone and diaphragm packaging
publicationTitle: 22nd International Symposium on High Voltage Engineering (ISH 2021)
